items.aliasZh: PINK · 世上最粉的粉 · Culture Hustle · 2016
items.aliasEn: PINK · the world's pinkest pink · Stuart Semple · 2016
items.histZh: 2016 年，英国雕塑家阿尼什·卡普尔从英国公司 Surrey NanoSystems 拿到了 Vantablack 在艺术领域的独家使用权。Vantablack 是一种碳纳米管涂层，能吸收 99.965% 的可见光，平的东西看上去像个洞。艺术圈很不满：一种材料的视觉效果被一个人独占，还没有先例。英国艺术家斯图尔特·森普尔（Stuart Semple）的反击方式是做一种尽可能亮、尽可能哑光的荧光粉，取名就叫 PINK，然后公开卖 —— 卖给所有人，除了卡普尔。买家在结账前必须勾选一份声明：你不是阿尼什·卡普尔，与他没有任何关联，也不是替他或他的关联方购买。
items.histEn: In 2016 the sculptor Anish Kapoor obtained exclusive artistic rights to Vantablack from the British firm Surrey NanoSystems. Vantablack is a carbon nanotube coating that absorbs 99.965 per cent of visible light, so a flat surface looks like a hole. The art world objected: nothing like this had happened before, a single person taking a visual effect off the market. The British artist Stuart Semple hit back by making a fluorescent, extremely matte, maximally bright pink, calling it simply PINK, and selling it openly to everyone except Kapoor. Buyers must tick a declaration at checkout: you are not Anish Kapoor, you are not affiliated with him, and you are not buying it for him or his associates.
items.funZh: 卡普尔的回应是一张 Instagram 照片：一根涂满这个粉的中指，配文「Up yours #pink」。森普尔随后指控有人从内部把粉弄了出去，并说自己很失望。他的立场一直没变 —— 除非卡普尔开放黑色的使用权，否则粉不卖给他。此后他把同一套排他条款用到了几乎所有新品上：Black 2.0、Black 3.0、Black 4.0、更闪的闪粉；2024 年他索性把自己的名字改成了「Anish Kapoor」。关于这个粉有一个老实说必须交代的事实：它的亮度来自荧光，超出了 sRGB 能表示的范围，屏幕上的 #FF1493 只是个类比 —— 真东西在自然光下比屏幕上的任何粉都亮。
items.funEn: Kapoor's reply was an Instagram photograph of a middle finger dipped in the pink, captioned up yours #pink. Semple then accused someone of getting it to him from the inside and said he was disappointed. His position has not moved: unless Kapoor opens up the black, the pink stays off his shelf. He has since applied the same exclusion clause to nearly every new product, Black 2.0, Black 3.0 and Black 4.0 among them, and in 2024 he legally changed his own name to Anish Kapoor. One honest caveat about the colour: its brightness comes from fluorescence, which lies outside what sRGB can express. The #FF1493 on screen is an analogy, and the real thing under daylight is brighter than any pink a screen can show.

items.swZh: 嘲讽蒂芙尼蓝 · 免费送
items.aliasZh: Tiff Blue · 森普尔的蒂芙尼蓝 · 2021
items.histZh: 在粉色和黑色之后，森普尔把矛头对准了另一种更贵的颜色：蒂芙尼蓝。他的理由写在自己的商店页面上 —— 很多公司都为某个颜色注册过商标，比如 T-Mobile 的品红、可口可乐的红，但蒂芙尼蓝的区别在于，它的商标覆盖范围极广，涉及珠宝、香水、皮具、餐具、文具、书籍封面等一大串类别，而且潘通那个色号被藏起来不对公众开放。于是他做了一瓶哑光丙烯颜料，颜色尽量做到和它一致，取名叫 TIFF。
items.histEn: After pink and black, Semple aimed at a more expensive colour: Tiffany blue. His argument, written on his own shop page, is that plenty of companies have trademarked a colour, T-Mobile magenta and Coca-Cola red among them, but Tiffany blue is different because its marks spread across an unusually wide range of classes, jewellery, perfume, leather goods, tableware, stationery and book covers among them, and because the Pantone number is kept private. So he produced a matte acrylic mixed to match it and called it TIFF.
items.funZh: 蒂芙尼方面很快发来邮件要求停售。森普尔照办了，然后做了一件很他风格的事：他不卖了，改成免费送 —— 买他家的「最白的白」（White 2.0）就附赠一瓶 TIFF，等于绕开销售的说法继续把颜色散出去。瓶身上的品牌字样被划掉一半，露出后面的「TIFF」。顺带说一句公道话：法律界的评论普遍认为他把蒂芙尼的权利说得过头了 —— 颜色商标保护的不是「这个颜色」，而是它用在与特定商品相关、会让消费者误认的场合。但这个故事的重点不在这里，而在于它把「谁有权用某种颜色」这个问题重新摆到了台面上。
items.funEn: Tiffany sent an email telling him to stop. He complied, then did something very much in character: he stopped selling it and started giving it away, bundled free with his White 2.0, which kept the colour moving while sidestepping the sale. The wordmark on the bottle is half struck through, leaving TIFF. In fairness, legal commentary generally holds that he overstated Tiffany's rights: a colour trademark protects not the colour but its use in connection with particular goods in a way that confuses customers. The point of the episode is elsewhere, in putting the question of who is allowed to use a colour back on the table.

items.aliasZh: Pantone 448 C · 世界上最丑的颜色 · 暗浊棕
items.aliasEn: Pantone 448 C · the world's ugliest colour
items.histZh: 2012 年，澳大利亚政府委托研究机构 GfK Bluemoon 做一件少见的事：不要设计吸引人的包装，要设计让人不想买的包装。研究团队用三个月、七组研究、一千多名 16 到 64 岁的烟民，比较了石灰绿、白、米黄、深灰、芥末黄等一批候选颜色，要找出整体吸引力最低、看起来像最劣质、最有害的那一个。结果胜出的是 Pantone 448 C。
items.histEn: In 2012 the Australian government asked the research firm GfK Bluemoon to do something unusual: design packaging that would not attract buyers but repel them. Over three months and seven studies, with more than a thousand smokers aged 16 to 64, the team compared lime green, white, beige, dark grey, mustard and others, looking for the colour rated lowest in overall appeal and most suggestive of poor quality and harm. Pantone 448 C won.
items.funZh: 受访者描述这个颜色时用的词是「死亡」「肮脏」「焦油」，没有一个正面词。澳大利亚政府起初管它叫「橄榄绿」，结果澳大利亚橄榄协会写信抗议，说这是对橄榄品牌的侮辱 —— 于是官方改称「暗浊棕」。同一种颜色后来被英国、法国、爱尔兰、挪威、新西兰等许多国家用到了烟盒上。潘通自己的回应很有意思：「在潘通色彩研究所，我们认为所有颜色一律平等，不存在最丑的颜色。」
items.funEn: The words respondents used for it were death, dirty, tar, with no positive adjective among them. The Australian government first called it olive green, until the Australian Olive Association wrote in to protest that this insulted the olive brand, after which the official name became drab dark brown. The same colour later went onto cigarette packs in Britain, France, Ireland, Norway, New Zealand and many more. Pantone's own response is the best line in the story: at the Pantone Color Institute we consider all colours equal, and there is no such thing as the ugliest colour.

items.aliasZh: Vantablack · 碳纳米管涂层 · 屏幕无法表现
items.aliasEn: Vantablack · carbon nanotube coating · beyond any screen
items.histZh: 英国公司 Surrey NanoSystems 在 2014 年公布的一种碳纳米管涂层。它由垂直排列的极细管子组成，光进去以后在管子之间来回折射、被反复吸收，几乎出不来。公开的数字是吸收 99.965% 的可见光。它原本是为航天和军事用途开发的 —— 比如给望远镜挡杂散光。
items.histEn: A carbon nanotube coating announced by the British firm Surrey NanoSystems in 2014. It consists of vertical microscopic tubes, and light entering is deflected between them and absorbed over and over until almost none escapes. The published figure is 99.965 per cent of visible light. It was developed for aerospace and military use, among other things shielding telescopes from stray light.
items.funZh: 必须交代的是：任何十六进制的色号都表现不了它。屏幕上最黑的黑是 (0,0,0)，那是有光的屏幕能给出的极限；而 Vantablack 是让光进去不出来，所以一块涂满它的平面看上去不像黑色，像没有东西。周围世界的明暗关系在它边上全部失效 —— 这就是为什么照片里它总像被挖掉了一块。
items.funEn: One thing has to be said plainly: no hex value can represent it. The darkest black a screen can make is (0,0,0), which is the limit of a display that emits light; Vantablack works by letting light in and not letting it out, so a coated surface does not read as black but as nothing. The relationships of light and shade that organise everything around it stop applying, which is why in photographs it always looks like a hole cut out of the picture.

items.aliasZh: 超白涂料 · 硫酸钡 · 普渡大学 2021
items.aliasEn: Ultra white paint · barium sulfate · Purdue, 2021
items.histZh: 2021 年，美国普渡大学的研究团队做出了一种含高浓度硫酸钡颗粒的白色涂料，能反射约 98.1% 的太阳光。做法不是把颜料磨得更细，而是故意把颗粒做成不同大小：不同尺寸的颗粒负责散射不同波长的光，合起来几乎把整个太阳光谱都挡回去。目标很实际 —— 涂在建筑屋顶上，让它在日光下比周围环境还凉。
items.histEn: In 2021 a team at Purdue University produced a white paint loaded with barium sulfate particles that reflects about 98.1 per cent of sunlight. The trick is not finer grinding but deliberately mixed particle sizes: different sizes scatter different wavelengths, and together they turn back nearly the whole solar spectrum. The goal was practical, to coat roofs so they stay cooler than the air around them in direct sun.
items.funZh: 它和 Vantablack 正好是一对：一个把光全放走，一个把光全挡回去，两个都超出了屏幕能表示的范围 —— 你在屏幕上看到的 #FFFFFF 其实只是「屏幕能给出的最白」，并不是白得反光的白。这类研究的共同点也很有意思：它们争的不是好看，是一种可测量的物理指标。
items.funEn: It is the exact counterpart of Vantablack, one letting all the light out and the other turning it all back, and both lie outside what a display can show. The #FFFFFF you see on screen is only the whitest a screen can manage, not a white that throws light back. These projects share something else too: what they compete over is not beauty but a measurable physical number.

items.swZh: 金门大桥 · 底漆变招牌
items.aliasZh: 国际橙 · International Orange · 金门大桥与宇航服
items.aliasEn: International orange · the Golden Gate Bridge and space suits
items.histZh: 金门大桥 1930 年代施工时，钢构件出厂就刷了一层橙红色的防锈底漆。建筑师欧文·莫罗看到以后决定不覆盖它 —— 理由是：这个颜色在旧金山常见的浓雾里看得清楚，而且和周围的海与山配起来好看。海军当时希望桥刷成黑黄条纹以利于船舶识别，被否掉了。于是这种橙成了世界上最著名的一座桥的颜色。
items.histEn: When the Golden Gate Bridge was built in the 1930s the steel arrived already coated in an orange-red anti-corrosion primer. The consulting architect Irving Morrow decided not to paint over it, on two grounds: the colour stays visible in the heavy fog that San Francisco gets, and it looks right against the water and hills. The Navy had wanted black and yellow stripes for visibility to shipping, and lost. So that orange became the colour of the most famous bridge there is.
items.funZh: 同一个橙在另一个地方用途完全不同：美国宇航局的舱内宇航服也用这个色系，因为搜救人员需要在海面或荒野里最快找到那个亮点。有意思的是它的两个用途刚好对应颜色的两种功能 —— 一个是为了让人看见（安全），一个是为了让人爱看（美观）。金门大桥同时占了这两条。
items.funEn: The same orange has a completely different job elsewhere: NASA's launch-and-entry suits use this family of colour because recovery crews need to spot the wearer on water or open ground as fast as possible. The two uses map neatly onto the two things colour does, one for being seen and one for being looked at, and the bridge manages both at once.

items.aliasZh: Viva Magenta · 潘通 2023 年度色 · 胭脂虫红的后代
items.aliasEn: Viva magenta · Pantone colour of the year 2023 · a descendant of cochineal
items.histZh: 潘通从 2000 年起每年选一个「年度色」，用来给下一年的产品开发定调；这套机制本身已经变成一个全球性的营销事件 —— 宣布之后，家居、服装、包装、网页都会跟着调色。2023 年选出的这个红叫 Viva Magenta，编号 18-1750。潘通自己的说法是：它取自胭脂虫红（cochineal），也就是那种从虫子身上来的、最古老的天然红色染料之一。
items.histEn: Since 2000 Pantone has picked a colour of the year to set the tone for the following season's product development, and the mechanism has itself become a global marketing event: once it is announced, interiors, clothing, packaging and websites shift toward it. The 2023 choice was a red called Viva Magenta, numbered 18-1750. Pantone's own account is that it derives from cochineal, one of the oldest natural reds there is, and one that comes from an insect.
items.funZh: 这件事值得多想一层：一个被批评为「把颜色卖成标准」的机构，选了一个几百年历史的虫染红作为年度色。而前面那条「胭脂红」也在名单里 —— 同一个来源，一个以古代颜料的名义留下，一个以当代商业的名义出现。两份名单放在一起看，颜色史和潮流的距离其实没那么远。
items.funEn: Worth a second thought: an organisation criticised for selling colour as a standard chose as its colour of the year an insect dye with centuries behind it. And cochineal carmine is in this collection too, the same source appearing once as an ancient pigment and once as a contemporary commercial pick. Put the two lists side by side and the distance between colour history and trend turns out to be short.

items.aliasZh: 美元绿 · Dollar Bill Green · 绿背
items.histZh: 美国内战期间财政吃紧，1861 年起联邦政府开始大规模发行纸币。之所以印成绿色，原因很实在：绿色颜料便宜、稳定，而且当时的摄影还是黑白的，用绿墨印能明显提高翻拍伪造的难度。这批纸币很快被叫做「绿背」（greenbacks），绿色从此和美元绑在了一起。
items.histEn: With the Treasury under strain during the Civil War, the federal government began issuing paper money on a large scale from 1861. The green was a practical decision: green ink was cheap and stable, and since photography was still black and white at the time, printing in green made photographic counterfeiting markedly harder. The notes were soon nicknamed greenbacks, and green has been bound to the dollar ever since.
items.funZh: 后来技术变了，伪造的难度不再由颜色决定，但绿色没变 —— 一百六十多年过去，美元还是绿的，而当年的那个理由（防翻拍）已经完全失效。这件事很能说明颜色和功能的关系：一开始是功能选了颜色，后来是习惯留住了颜色。
items.funEn: The technology changed, and counterfeiting difficulty stopped depending on colour, but the green stayed. A hundred and sixty years on the dollar is still green and the original reason, defeating photographic reproduction, has been dead for a century. It says something about how colour and function relate: function picked the colour first, and habit kept it.

items.aliasZh: YInMn 蓝 · 钇铟锰蓝 · 俄勒冈州立大学
items.aliasEn: YInMn blue · yttrium indium manganese · Oregon State
items.histZh: 2009 年，俄勒冈州立大学的马斯·苏布拉马尼亚姆让学生把氧化钇、氧化铟和氧化锰放进炉子，原意是找一种能做电子的材料，结果烧出一块鲜艳的蓝。他后来在采访里说，自己把炉子关了又开、开了又关，只是不停地说「哇」。这种蓝耐热耐晒、极稳定，也不含钴或铜那类有麻烦的金属。它属于「多铁性材料」研究的一个副产品 —— 课题组当时在找能同时具备两种电磁性质的化合物，颜色是意外收获。它的化学结构是钇铟锰氧化物，六方晶格，结构本身就决定了这个蓝极难褪。
items.histEn: In 2009 Mas Subramanian's group at Oregon State had a student heat yttrium oxide, indium oxide and manganese oxide together, looking for an electronic material. What came out was a vivid blue. In interviews afterwards he described opening and closing the furnace again and again, saying only: wow. The colour is heat-stable, light-stable, and free of the troublesome metals in cobalt and copper blues. It came out of work on multiferroic materials: the group was hunting compounds with two electrical and magnetic properties at once, and the colour was a by-product. Chemically it is a yttrium indium manganese oxide with a hexagonal lattice, and the structure itself is what makes the blue so hard to bleach.
items.funZh: 颜料史上一个真正新的、稳定的无机蓝，已经两百年没出现过 —— 上一个还是 19 世纪初的钴蓝。它在 2016 年开始商业化，2017 年有了以它为基础的蜡笔。人类等这个蓝等了整整两个世纪。颜料行业对新蓝的谨慎是有理由的：19 世纪的巴黎绿因为毒性被禁，20 世纪的一些新颜色后来也出过问题。所以 YInMn 蓝 2016 年商业化之后，又花了几年才进消费市场。
items.funEn: A genuinely new and stable inorganic blue had not appeared in two hundred years — the last had been cobalt blue in the early 1800s. YInMn blue was commercialised from 2016 and became a crayon in 2017. The wait had been two centuries long. The pigment trade has reason to be cautious about a new blue: Paris green was banned for toxicity, and some 20th-century newcomers caused trouble later. Even after commercialisation in 2016, it took a few more years to reach consumers.

items.histZh: 1775 年，瑞典化学家卡尔·舍勒做出亚砷酸铜 —— 一种便宜又鲜艳的绿。它很快被用在壁纸、蜡烛、玩具，以及妇女绿裙子里的衬布上。亚砷酸铜的好处是便宜、颜色艳，而且能直接用在纸上，所以它从壁纸扩散到了人造花、蜡烛、衣服和儿童玩具。当时没人做过长期毒性评估 —— 这个做法要等到 20 世纪才变成常规。
items.histEn: In 1775 the Swedish chemist Carl Wilhelm Scheele produced copper arsenite: cheap and vivid green. It went quickly onto wallpaper, candles, toys, and the linings of green dresses. Copper arsenite was cheap, vivid, and could be applied directly to paper, so it spread from wallpaper into artificial flowers, candles, clothing and children's toys. Nobody ran a long-term toxicity assessment, a practice that would not become routine until the 20th century.
items.funZh: 它含砷。「维多利亚时代壁纸杀人」这个流传很广的说法说的就是它 —— 潮湿房间里，霉菌可能把颜料里的砷转化成有毒的气体（机制仍有争议，但砷在潮湿环境下确实会跑出来）。拿破仑被流放时房间的壁纸正是绿的，他是否死于慢性砷中毒，到今天还有研究在争。也有研究者认为，壁纸砷中毒这个说法的流行程度超过了它的证据强度。但有一点是实打实的：它推动了第一轮消费品安全监管。
items.funEn: It contains arsenic. The much-repeated story of Victorian wallpaper killing people is about this pigment: in damp rooms, mould may convert arsenic in the paint into a harmful gas, a mechanism still argued over, though arsenic certainly can move in wet conditions. The wallpaper in Napoleon's room in exile was green, and whether he died of chronic arsenic poisoning is still under discussion. Some historians argue the wallpaper story became more famous than its evidence warranted. What is solid is that it helped push the first round of consumer product safety regulation.

items.swEn: The glow on a watch dial
items.aliasZh: 镭绿 · 20 世纪初 · 镭女郎
items.histZh: 20 世纪初，镭被发现之后被当成万能的健康元素，进了牙膏、化妆品、饮用水，也进了钟表的夜光涂料。那种夜里会亮的绿色，是第一代「夜光色」。夜光涂料的原理是硫化锌掺微量镭：镭负责持续激发，硫化锌负责发光。所以真正发光的是锌，真正危险的是镭 —— 这个区别在当时几乎没人分得清，广告也刻意模糊。
items.histEn: After radium was discovered in the early 1900s it was sold as a cure-all, turning up in toothpaste, cosmetics, drinking water and in luminous watch paint. That green glow in the dark was the first luminous colour. The paint was zinc sulphide with a trace of radium in it: the radium kept the zinc excited, the zinc did the glowing. So the light came from zinc and the danger came from radium, a distinction almost nobody made at the time and one that advertising kept blurred.
items.funZh: 涂表盘要用嘴唇把笔尖抿出尖来，也就是所谓的点唇法，每天会吞下微量镭。这批女工后来被称为「镭女郎」，很多人在二十几岁就开始牙齿脱落、下颌骨坏死。这个绿大概是消费史上代价最高的一种颜色。这件事后来改变了劳动法：它直接推动了职业病认定、工人赔偿和工业卫生标准。一个颜色换来一整套制度，代价是几十个年轻人的下颌骨。
items.funEn: Pointing the brush with the lips — lip-pointing — is how the numbers were painted, and it meant swallowing a little radium every day. The women doing it became known as the Radium Girls; many lost their teeth and parts of their jaws while still in their twenties. Of all the colours in consumer history, this one was probably the most expensive. It changed labour law: the case drove the recognition of occupational disease, workers' compensation and industrial hygiene standards. One colour bought a whole regulatory framework, paid for with the jaws of a few dozen young women.

items.swZh: 传说 · 没换过的衬衫
items.aliasZh: 伊莎贝拉色 · 偏暖的灰白 · 来源不可靠
items.aliasEn: Isabelline · a warm off-white · doubtful origin
items.histZh: 一种偏暖的灰白，也有人说是淡黄褐。名字据说来自西班牙的伊莎贝拉女王：传说她发誓在攻下格拉纳达之前不换内衣，于是出现了一种介于白与污之间的颜色。这个说法流传很广，但研究普遍认为不可靠，色名更可能只是灰色系里的一支。语言学上更可能的解释是：它借的只是「伊莎贝拉」这个名字在中世纪欧洲的流行程度 —— 一种颜色被叫成某人名的变体，和叫成藕、绛是同一类操作，只不过借的是人而不是物。
items.histEn: A warm off-white, sometimes described as a pale yellowish brown. The name is said to come from Queen Isabella of Spain, who is supposed to have sworn not to change her underclothes until Granada fell — leaving a colour somewhere between white and soiled. The story is widely told and widely doubted; the name is more likely a branch of the greys. The more likely linguistic account is that it borrows simply from how common the name Isabella was in medieval Europe: a colour named after a person rather than an object, the same maneuver as naming one after a fruit or a fabric.
items.funZh: 「伊莎贝拉」这个名字除了颜色，还给了至少两种动物：伊莎贝拉熊和伊莎贝拉蛾，据说和同一段传说有关。一个可靠性存疑的故事，硬是生出了三个命名。不管故事真假，它今天在鸟类学里活得很好 —— 伊莎贝拉色是许多鸟类图鉴里描述羽色的标准词，一用就是上百年。
items.funEn: The name Isabella also attached itself to at least two animals — the Isabella bear and the Isabella moth — on the strength of the same story. One doubtful anecdote, three separate names. True or not, the word thrives in ornithology: isabelline is a standard term in bird guides for describing plumage, and has been for a century or more.

items.swEn: The pale grey of a dove
items.aliasZh: 鸽灰 · 偏蓝的浅灰 · 常配粉
items.aliasEn: Dove grey · a cool pale grey · paired with pink
items.histZh: 鸽子羽毛上那种偏蓝的浅灰。作为色名在 18 到 19 世纪的欧洲织物目录里很常见。鸽灰属于「灰但有色」的那一档 —— 灰里带蓝，或者带粉。这类颜色在 18 到 19 世纪的织物和室内设计里是主角，因为当时的染色工艺还做不出高饱和，带调子的灰反而是最容易做到高级的一档。
items.histEn: The pale, faintly blue grey of a dove's plumage. It appears constantly in European textile catalogues of the 18th and 19th centuries. Dove grey belongs to the family of greys that are not neutral: grey with blue in it, or pink. Colours like this dominated textiles and interiors from the 18th century into the 19th, because dyeing of the period could not deliver saturation, and tinted greys were the easiest route to something refined.
items.funZh: 鸽灰配粉是一门老配色，理由是它们都带一点灰，谁都不抢谁。维多利亚时期的室内设计手册里就有这一条 —— 换句话说，这个搭配比大多数现代配色指南都老。它也是少数在东、西方色名体系里都存在的颜色 —— 鸽子的灰各地都差不多，所以这个词几乎是顺着鸟飞过去的。
items.funEn: Dove grey with pink is an old pairing, and it works because both colours carry some grey, so neither dominates. It is already recommended in Victorian interior design manuals — an arrangement older than most modern colour guides. It is also one of the few colours that exists as a name in both Eastern and Western systems: a dove's grey is much the same everywhere, so the word almost flew along with the bird.

items.aliasZh: 爱丽丝蓝 · 网页内建色 · aliceblue
items.aliasEn: Alice blue · built into the web as aliceblue
items.histZh: 19 世纪末开始出现在美国织物目录里的浅蓝。一般说法认为它来自西奥多·罗斯福总统的女儿爱丽丝·罗斯福 —— 说这颜色配她的眼睛。它进入网页颜色标准的方式很朴素：早期浏览器规定了一组具名的颜色，它就在其中。也就是说，一个 19 世纪的纱线色，靠一段规范文字活到了二十一世纪。
items.histEn: A pale blue that appears in American textile catalogues from the late 19th century. The usual account traces it to Alice Roosevelt, daughter of President Theodore Roosevelt, and says the colour matched her eyes. How it got into the web colour specification is unglamorous: early browsers defined a set of named colours and it was among them. A 19th-century yarn shade survived into the 21st century on the strength of a specification document.
items.funZh: 它后来被写进了网页颜色标准，成了一条内建色（aliceblue），也是这个标准里极少数以人名命名的颜色之一。一张 19 世纪的纱线色卡，通过 HTML 活到了今天。顺带一提，「爱丽丝蓝」和《爱丽丝梦游仙境》没有关系 —— 它比那本书晚，也比那本书死板得多。名字相近，来路完全不同。
items.funEn: It later became a reserved keyword in the web colour specification — aliceblue — and stands among the very few names in that list taken from a person. A 19th-century yarn swatch survived into the present through HTML. Worth noting: Alice blue has nothing to do with Alice in Wonderland. It postdates the book and is far stiffer than it. Similar names, unrelated origins.

items.aliasZh: 蓬巴杜玫瑰粉 · 塞夫勒最贵的釉色之一
items.aliasEn: Rose Pompadour · among Sèvres' costliest glazes
items.histZh: 1757 年法国的塞夫勒瓷器厂做出一款新的粉红釉，一般说法是献给路易十五的情人蓬巴杜夫人，后来就叫蓬巴杜玫瑰。这种釉烧成率很低，一直是塞夫勒最贵的釉色之一。蓬巴杜夫人本人是塞夫勒瓷厂的实质推动者，她常年在宫里用这些瓷器宴客，等于持续做广告。所以这个粉色一半是工艺，一半是宫廷的人脉 —— 颜色也是需要代言人的。
items.histEn: In 1757 the Sèvres porcelain works developed a new pink glaze, said to have been offered to Madame de Pompadour, mistress of Louis XV, and named for her thereafter. The glaze was hard to fire successfully, which kept it among the most expensive colours Sèvres offered. Madame de Pompadour was in effect the works' promoter, serving Sèvres at court for years and functioning as continuous advertising. Half the pink is chemistry and half is court connections: a colour needs a patron too.
items.funZh: 塞夫勒的这种粉靠叠烧：先上一层粉，再罩一层透明釉，窑温差一点就前功尽弃。所以 18 世纪买一套粉釉瓷器，价钱能到普通釉的好几倍 —— 一个粉，靠成品率把自己抬成了奢侈品。今天你在博物馆里看到的塞夫勒粉，大多比它刚出窑时淡一点 —— 粉釉同样会受光老化，这一点和前面那些颜料是一回事。
items.funEn: The Sèvres pink is built in layers — a pink ground, then a clear glaze over it — and a small error in the kiln ruins the piece. A pink service in the 18th century could cost several times an ordinary one. The colour became a luxury through yield rates rather than rarity of material. The Sèvres pinks in museums today are usually a little paler than they were at the kiln, because pink glazes age in light as well — the same story as the pigments.

items.swEn: The colour of a flea's back
items.aliasZh: 跳蚤色 · 法语就是跳蚤 · 暗红褐
items.aliasEn: Puce · French for flea · a dark red-brown
items.histZh: 法语 puce 就是跳蚤，这个颜色指的是暗红褐。一般的说法把它归到 18 世纪法国宫廷：某位贵族穿了这个色，事后据说是为了盖住跳蚤。它在 18 世纪的法国是有实际地位的流行色，出现过各种变体名（跳蚤背、跳蚤腹、跳蚤腿），按深浅分档。一个颜色能分出解剖学级别的细目，说明当时的社交场合确实在盯着衣服看。
items.histEn: Puce is French for flea, and the colour named is a dark red-brown. The usual story places it in the 18th-century French court, where a figure at court wore the colour and the explanation offered afterwards was fleas. In 18th-century France it was genuinely fashionable, with variants named after parts of the animal — flea back, flea belly, flea leg — graded by depth. A colour that can be subdivided anatomically tells you something about how closely a room was looking at clothes.
items.funZh: 这个说法可靠性一般，但它是颜色由事件命名的典型：名字里带着一个当时谁都懂的尴尬，于是传下来了。今天法语里 puce 基本被深红褐取代，只剩色卡还留着它。它后来在英语里带上了贬义 —— 说一件衣服是 puce，往往是在暗示这颜色不讨喜。一个从跳蚤来的名字，很难摆脱出身。
items.funEn: The reliability is mediocre, but it is a textbook case of a colour named after an incident: the name carries an embarrassment everyone at the time understood, which is why it survived. In French today puce has largely been replaced by plainer descriptions, leaving only the colour charts. In English it later picked up a sneer: calling a garment puce is usually a way of saying the colour is unfortunate. A name that came from a flea has trouble escaping where it came from.

items.aliasZh: 贝克-米勒粉 · 关押粉 · 结果有争议
items.aliasEn: Baker-Miller pink · the results are contested
items.histZh: 1979 年，美国的两名研究人员亚历山大·肖斯和约翰·巴克把加州一所海军拘留中心的两间牢房刷成了粉红。他们报告说，被关进去的人明显更冷静。配方也被公开过：白漆里掺特定的红，比例误差稍大效果就不一样。后来很多机构照着刷，结果各不相同 —— 这也说明「颜色影响情绪」这个结论本身太脆弱，经不起换个房间、换个光照。
items.histEn: In 1979 two American researchers, Alexander Schauss and John Baker, had two holding cells at a naval facility in California painted pink. Their report said those held in them calmed noticeably. The recipe was published too: white paint with a set proportion of a particular red, where a slightly off ratio changes the result. Institutions repainted accordingly and got different outcomes, which tells you how fragile the whole colour-changes-mood proposition is: it does not survive a new room or new lighting.
items.funZh: 因为这个研究，这种粉被叫作贝克-米勒粉，也叫「关押粉」，一度在监狱、球队更衣室和学校走廊里推广。后来的重复研究结果并不一致，很多场合已经刷回去了 —— 但它作为一个「颜色影响行为」的案例被记住了。它今天最可靠的用途反而是数据之外的：粉色的更衣室、粉色的球场，在体育转播里仍然看得见。一个被证伪的心理学结论，留下了一个真实的视觉传统。
items.funEn: From that study came the name Baker-Miller pink, and the nickname drunk tank pink. It was tried in jails, in team locker rooms and in school corridors. Later attempts to repeat the result were inconsistent and many places painted over it, but it remains the reference case for colour changing behaviour. Its most dependable career today is visual rather than psychological: pink locker rooms and pink end zones still turn up on sports broadcasts. A disproven theory left behind a real tradition.

items.aliasZh: Marrs 绿 · 世界最受欢迎的颜色 · 2017
items.aliasEn: Marrs green · voted the world's favourite · 2017
items.histZh: 2017 年英国一家纸业公司做了一次横跨一百多个国家的调查，让人挑自己最喜欢的颜色，最后得到的是一种偏蓝的绿，以发起这项调查的公司董事长的姓氏命名。这类投票选出来的颜色和潘通年度色是同一物种：由机构发起、有商业目的、结果被广泛报道。区别只是它打着「全世界最受欢迎」的旗号，听起来像结论，实际更像问卷。
items.histEn: In 2017 a British paper company ran a survey across more than a hundred countries asking people to choose their favourite colour. What came out was a blue-leaning green, named after the surname of the company's chairman. Colours chosen by vote and colours of the year are the same species: launched by an organisation, commercially motivated, widely reported. The difference is that this one flew the flag of the world's favourite, which sounds more like a finding than a survey.
items.funZh: 一次投票选出的颜色，和一块矿石、一种染料选出来的颜色性质完全不同 —— 它是「人气的平均值」。这样的颜色每隔几年就会出现一个，潘通的年度色是同一操作的商业版本。有意思的是，这类调查选出来的颜色往往非常安全 —— 蓝绿、灰蓝、柔粉。让不同文化的人一起投票，结果会往温和的方向收，这本身就是个结论。
items.funEn: A colour elected by vote is a different kind of thing from one dug out of the ground or boiled in a vat: it is an average of preference. Colours like this appear every few years, and Pantone's colour of the year is the commercial edition of the same operation. What such surveys tend to produce is remarkably safe colours: teal, grey-blue, soft pink. Ask people across cultures to vote together and the answer drifts toward the middle, which is itself the interesting finding.

items.aliasZh: 青瓷色 · 名字来自一部法国小说的人物
items.aliasEn: Celadon · named after a character in a French novel
items.histZh: 中国青瓷的釉色。欧洲人给它的名字是 celadon，一般说法来自 17 世纪一部法国流行小说里的人物 Céladon —— 一个身上系着青绿缎带的牧羊人。瓷器运到欧洲之后，人们就用这个角色的名字称呼那种青绿。青瓷在欧洲的收藏史里长期被当成玉的替代品 —— 釉色、开片和温润的手感都在模仿玉。所以这个颜色在欧洲的语境里，从一开始就带着「东方、贵重、古物」这三层意思。
items.histEn: The glaze colour of Chinese celadon ware. In Europe it acquired the name celadon, generally traced to the character Céladon in a popular 17th-century French novel, who wore pale green ribbons. Once the porcelain reached Europe, the character's name was applied to the colour of the glaze. In European collections celadon was long treated as a substitute for jade: the glaze, the crackle, the soft touch all imitate it. So in a European context the colour arrived already carrying three meanings — Eastern, valuable, antique.
items.funZh: 也就是说，欧洲人拿一部小说的角色名给中国的瓷釉取了名。同一个颜色，中国叫青瓷（材料名），欧洲叫雪拉同（人物名）—— 两个命名系统各自都说得通。同一个颜色，中国叫青瓷是讲材料和工艺，欧洲叫 celadon 是讲一个人物。两个命名系统各自都能自洽，也各自漏掉了对方在意的部分。
items.funEn: So Europe named a Chinese glaze after a character in a novel. One colour, called by its material in China and by a person's name in Europe, and both systems make complete sense within themselves. One colour: in China the name speaks of material and craft, in Europe of a fictional character. Both systems are internally consistent, and each leaves out what the other cares about.

items.swEn: Slag from a Swedish copper mine
items.aliasZh: 法伦红 · 瑞典木屋的标准色
items.aliasEn: Falu red · the standard Swedish cottage colour
items.histZh: 瑞典法伦的大铜矿出了几百年的铜，矿渣里带着铁和铜的化合物。从 16 世纪起，当地人把这些矿渣掺进涂料里刷木屋，得到的深红既防腐又便宜。它最早是用来刷木屋外墙防腐的，后来才成了审美选择。涂料里含铜和铁的化合物，能抑制真菌和虫蛀，所以在功能上接近今天的防腐木漆 —— 好看是副产物。
items.histEn: The great copper mine at Falun in Sweden produced copper for centuries, and its slag carried iron and copper compounds. From the 16th century people mixed that slag into paint for timber houses, getting a deep red that was both rot-resistant and cheap. It began as a preservative for timber walls and only later became an aesthetic choice. The paint carries copper and iron compounds that suppress fungus and insects, which puts it close to a modern wood preservative. Looking good was a side effect.
items.funZh: 这个红后来成了瑞典乡间木屋的标准色 —— 在瑞典乡下看到的一大片红房子，几乎都是它。一种颜色如果足够便宜、足够耐用，就会替一个国家定下风景。一个颜色如果能同时满足便宜、耐用、好看，它就会替一个国家定下风景。这件事在瑞典发生过，在别的地方也是同一套逻辑。
items.funEn: The red went on to become the standard colour of Swedish country cottages: the fields of red houses you see across rural Sweden are almost all this. A colour cheap enough and durable enough ends up deciding what a country looks like. When a colour is cheap, durable and handsome at once, it ends up deciding what a country looks like. That happened in Sweden, and the logic holds elsewhere.

items.aliasZh: 蓝晒蓝 · 铁盐工艺 · 来源是普鲁士蓝
items.aliasEn: Cyanotype blue · an iron process · Prussian blue under it
items.histZh: 1842 年，英国天文学家兼化学家约翰·赫歇尔发现柠檬酸铁铵和铁氰化钾混合后见光会变蓝，用水冲掉没曝光的部分就留下蓝色影像，这就是蓝晒法。它最早的重要用途是给植物做标本记录。它后来在工程界活得比在艺术界更好 —— 二十世纪的工程图纸蓝晒图就是这么来的，「蓝图」这个词也是从这套工艺来的。所以蓝晒法有两个身份：摄影的起点，和工业制图的工具。
items.histEn: In 1842 the British astronomer and chemist John Herschel found that a mix of ammonium iron citrate and potassium ferricyanide turns blue in light, and that washing away the unexposed part leaves a blue image. That is the cyanotype. Its first serious use was recording plant specimens. It did better in engineering than in art: the blueprints of the 20th century came off cyanotype, and the word blueprint descends from the process. So the cyanotype has two identities — the beginning of photography, and a tool of industry.
items.funZh: 蓝晒法的蓝其实就是普鲁士蓝，一种和摄影同龄的颜料。它也是少数你能在家里自己配的古典工艺：两种铁盐、阳光、水，不需要银 —— 所以它对想动手的人特别友好。和银盐不同，蓝晒法的成像是靠铁的氧化还原，不需要贵金属，也不需要暗房。所以它是古典工艺里最容易上手的一种，也常被直接用来在布料上印相。
items.funEn: The blue it makes is Prussian blue, a pigment of the same vintage as photography itself. It is also one of the few historical processes you can mix up at home: two iron salts, sunlight and water, with no silver involved, which makes it unusually welcoming to anyone who wants to try. Unlike silver processes, cyanotype images come from the chemistry of iron, needing no precious metal and no darkroom. That makes it the most approachable of the historical processes, and it is often used to print directly onto cloth.

items.aliasZh: 棕褐 · 老照片的代称 · sepia 滤镜
items.histZh: sepia 本来指乌贼墨里的色素。它在摄影里成了老照片的代称，是因为 19 世纪后期到 20 世纪中期的相纸常用硫化物调色，把银影像转成棕褐，稳定性比纯银的好。调色的目的是稳定：银影像本身会慢慢氧化发黄甚至褪掉，转成棕褐之后稳定性明显提高。所以老照片的棕首先是技术选择，审美是后来才追认上去的。
items.histEn: Sepia originally meant the pigment in cuttlefish ink. It became shorthand for old photographs because from the late 19th century through the mid-20th, print papers were often toned with sulphur compounds, converting the silver image to a brown and making it more stable than plain silver. The point of toning was stability: a silver image oxidises, yellows and can fade, and converting it to a brown improved how long it lasted considerably. So the brown of old photographs was a technical decision first; the aesthetic was granted afterwards.
items.funZh: 今天修图软件里那个 sepia 滤镜，模仿的是当年的相纸，不是乌贼。一个生物名最后变成了一个滤镜 —— 颜色词的生命周期往往比它的来源长得多。今天软件里的 sepia 滤镜有一个常见的错：它把整张图统一染棕，而真实的老照片是有层次差异的 —— 暗部更黑、高光更暖。这个差别大到一眼能看出来。
items.funEn: The sepia filter in editing software imitates the paper, not the cuttlefish. A biological name ended up as a filter: colour words routinely outlive what they were named after. The sepia filter in software usually makes one standard mistake: it tints the whole image uniformly, whereas a real toned print varies by value — deeper in the shadows, warmer in the highlights. The difference is visible at a glance.

items.aliasZh: 长春花蓝 · 潘通第一次为年度色造新色
items.aliasEn: Very Peri · the first invented colour of the year
items.histZh: 潘通每年选一个年度色。2022 年选的是这个偏紫的蓝，也是潘通第一次为年度色专门造一个新颜色 —— 其他年份都是从现有色卡里挑一个。潘通做这类发布的流程一直被人讨论：它先看文化趋势、技术和情绪，再定色，然后同步推给纺织、涂料和消费品客户。所以年度色公布的时候，供应链其实已经动了 —— 我们看到的是一次事先铺好的共识。
items.histEn: Pantone names a colour of the year. For 2022 it chose this purple-leaning blue, and for the first time created a new colour specifically for the occasion rather than picking from the existing library. Pantone's process has been much discussed: it reads cultural trends, technology and mood, picks a colour, then feeds it to textile, paint and consumer clients at the same time. By the time a colour of the year is announced the supply chain is already moving, so what we see is a consensus that has been arranged.
items.funZh: 潘通的说法是，这是数字世界里的蓝，带红调。反对意见也有：有人说它像小时候那种廉价圆珠笔的紫。年度色从来不只是颜色，它是一次公共讨论的引子。拿它和真的长春花对比时，常常有人失望 —— 花是柔和的，屏幕上这个值要亮得多。这又是一次「屏幕比实物鲜艳」的老问题。
items.funEn: Pantone's account is that this is a blue for the digital world, carrying red inside it. The objection was equally quick: some said it looks like the purple of a cheap ballpoint from childhood. A colour of the year is never only a colour — it is a prompt for an argument. Compared with an actual periwinkle flower it disappoints people: the flower is soft, the value on a screen is far brighter. Another round of the old problem of displays out-brightening the world.

items.aliasZh: 蜜桃绒 · 柔软的浅桃 · 供应链色
items.aliasEn: Peach Fuzz · a soft peach · a supply-chain colour
items.histZh: 潘通 2024 年的年度色，一种柔软的浅桃色。同一年，手机和家纺里也集中出现了一批粉色系，这两件事不是巧合 —— 年度色会影响纺织、室内和消费电子的备货。潘通给它的说明里提到了触感和软，也就是说年度色的措辞已经从颜色转向感受 —— 这几年发布的颜色多半配着一套情绪形容词，颜色只是那些形容词的载体。
items.histEn: Pantone's colour for 2024, a soft pale peach. In the same year a run of pinks appeared across phones and home textiles. The two are not unrelated: a colour of the year feeds into what textiles, interiors and consumer electronics order in advance. Pantone's own wording leaned on touch and softness, meaning the language of a colour of the year has moved from colour to feeling. Recent picks come with a set of mood adjectives attached; the colour is the vehicle for them.
items.funZh: 年度色发布之后的一年里，你会在商场里突然看见大量同一个颜色 —— 因为很多厂的排产是一年前就定好的。颜色是有供应链的。它是典型的「屏幕友好、实物难做」的颜色 —— 桃色在纺织品上非常容易偏灰或者发脏，要染得干净，成本比看起来高得多。
items.funEn: In the year after a colour of the year is announced you suddenly see a great deal of it in shops, because production runs were fixed twelve months earlier. Colour has a supply chain. It is a textbook screen-friendly, material-hostile colour: peach on textiles greys out or muddies very easily, and producing a clean one costs far more than it looks like it should.

items.swZh: 制服色 · 目的是看不见
items.swEn: A uniform colour meant to hide
items.aliasZh: 军绿 · 一战前后 · 配方随年代变
items.aliasEn: Olive drab · the formula changed with the decade
items.histZh: 军装用的橄榄褐，一战前后成为美军的标准制服色，目的是降低战场上的可见度。它是一整套系统的产物：不同战场、不同季节需要不同的可见度，所以军方会按地形和光照发布色卡。这套做法的思路后来被民用化，成了今天的迷彩和户外装备配色。
items.histEn: The olive brown of military clothing, which became the standard US uniform colour around the First World War with the simple aim of being harder to see. It is the product of a system: different theatres and seasons demand different visibility, so militaries published colour cards by terrain and light. That thinking was later civilianised into modern camouflage and outdoor gear palettes.
items.funZh: 军绿是个「技术色」：配方会随伪装需求、染料供应和成本改动，所以不同年代的军绿根本不是同一个色。在旧货店看军装的颜色，大致能判断年代。另外 olive drab 里的 drab 是单调、灰扑扑的意思，用来形容颜色本身并不客气。判断旧军装的年代，往往靠褪色的方式 —— 天然染料和合成染料的褪色顺序不一样，这一点有时比色号还准。
items.funEn: Olive drab is a technical colour whose formula moved with camouflage requirements, dye supply and cost, which means the olive of one decade is not the olive of another. The shade on a surplus jacket roughly dates it. And note that drab, in the name, means dull. Dating surplus uniforms often comes down to how they faded: natural and synthetic dyes lose their colour in different orders, which can be more reliable than the colour number.

items.aliasZh: 藏红花色 · 番红花雌蕊 · 最贵的香料之一
items.aliasEn: Saffron · crocus stigmas · among the costliest spices
items.histZh: 藏红花是番红花的雌蕊，既是极贵的香料，也是黄色染料。它的橙黄出现在佛教僧袍上，也出现在南亚一些旗帜上。它同时是染料、药材和仪式用品 —— 僧袍用藏红花染，一部分原因是这个颜色本身就带着仪式的含义。颜色、药效、信仰在同一样东西上叠了三层。
items.histEn: Saffron is the stigmas of the crocus: one of the most expensive spices, and a yellow dye as well. Its orange-yellow appears on Buddhist robes and on several South Asian flags. It served as dye, medicine and ritual material at once: saffron dyed the robes, partly because the colour already carried ceremony in it. One substance holding colour, cure and belief at the same time.
items.funZh: 收 1 公斤干藏红花大约要用 15 万朵花，全部靠手摘，所以它长期是世界上最贵的香料之一。用这么贵的东西去染布，在古代基本只有宗教和皇室负担得起。也因为这个，藏红花色在很多文化里都带着贵重、神圣的意思。采摘必须在清晨花朵刚开的时候完成，因为太阳一出来雌蕊里的活性成分就开始下降。所以这个颜色背后是一整套和天亮赛跑的劳动。
items.funEn: A kilogram of dried saffron takes roughly 150,000 flowers, all picked by hand, which keeps it among the most expensive spices on earth. Dyeing cloth with something that costly was affordable only to temples and courts, and that is why the colour carries an air of the sacred in so many places. Picking has to happen at dawn as the flowers open, because the active compounds in the stigmas begin to decline once the sun is up. Behind this colour is a whole trade of racing the sunrise.

items.aliasZh: 哈佛绯红 · 和耶鲁蓝的红蓝之争
items.histZh: 哈佛的校色。一般说法是 1858 年哈佛和耶鲁赛艇，两队都想要红，最后靠抽签决定：哈佛拿了深红，耶鲁拿了蓝。这类校色的故事在美国高校里不止一例，但抽签决定颜色的版本最常被引用 —— 因为它把一件本可以很麻烦的事处理成了一次抛硬币。校色后来进了校刊、运动队和周边商品，成了比校训更容易认出的东西。
items.histEn: Harvard's school colour. The usual account is that when Harvard and Yale raced in 1858 both crews wanted red, and a coin toss settled it: Harvard took crimson, Yale took blue. This is not the only school-colour story in American universities, but the coin-toss version gets cited most, because it turned a potentially endless argument into a single flip. The colour then went onto publications, teams and merchandise, ending up more recognisable than the motto.
items.funZh: 一场赛艇决定了两所学校的颜色，而且至今没改。很难找到比这更省事的决策方式。这两个颜色后来成了美国高校服装里固定的一组对照，红蓝之争也一直延续到现在。红蓝之争在校际比赛里被不断强化 —— 两个颜色的对比越被重复，它就越像天赋的差别，其实只是一枚硬币。
items.funEn: A boat race fixed two universities' colours, and neither has changed since. It would be hard to find a cheaper decision procedure. The pair later became a fixture of American collegiate clothing, and the argument between the two colours is still running. What keeps the red-blue argument alive is repetition at intercollegiate games: the more the contrast is rehearsed, the more it looks like a natural difference. It was a coin.

items.aliasZh: 苯胺品红 · 又名品红 · 英国叫 fuchsine
items.aliasEn: Aniline magenta · in Britain called fuchsine
items.histZh: 1859 年，法国的染料商几乎同时做出了苯胺品红染料。同年 6 月法奥两国在马真塔打了一仗，其中一家就把染料命名为 magenta 来纪念这场胜利；英国那边的叫法是 fuchsine。苯胺染料改变了纺织业的价格结构：以前一种新颜色要靠新矿、新虫、新树，之后可以靠实验室合成。品红这类颜色第一次让「鲜艳」变得便宜，也让化学工业第一次和时尚直接挂上了钩。
items.histEn: In 1859 French dye makers arrived at aniline magenta at almost the same moment. That June, France and Austria fought at Magenta, and one of the firms named its dye after the victory. In Britain the same colour was sold as fuchsine. Aniline dyes changed the economics of textiles: a new colour had once meant a new ore, a new insect or a new plant, and afterwards it could mean a laboratory. Magenta made brightness cheap for the first time, and put the chemical industry directly in touch with fashion.
items.funZh: 一个颜色由一次战役命名，而这场战役的伤亡以万计。染料史上这种命名即宣传的事不少 —— 名字从来不只是名字。这也是「时尚色」这个概念真正成立的时候 —— 颜色开始有季节、有流行、有过时。之前一个颜色能流行几十年，之后几年就换一轮，从此再没停下来。
items.funEn: A colour named for a battle in which casualties ran into the tens of thousands. The dye industry is full of naming as advertising: a name is never only a name. This is also when the idea of a fashion colour really took hold: colours began to have seasons, to be current, to go out. Before, one could stay in favour for decades; afterwards they turned over in a few years and have not stopped since.

items.histZh: 2002 年，两位天文学家把两万多个星系的光谱平均了一遍，算出了「宇宙的平均颜色」—— 一个极浅的米白。他们本来给的是一个更朴素的叫法，后来一位同事提议叫「宇宙拿铁」，媒体一转载就定下来了。这个色当然是整个宇宙的平均，不是任何一颗星星的颜色。屏幕上的值是原始计算结果的近似值。
items.histEn: In 2002 two astronomers averaged the spectra of more than twenty thousand galaxies and arrived at the average colour of the universe: an extremely pale off-white. Their original name for it was plainer, and a colleague suggested cosmic latte; the press picked the joke up and it stuck. It is of course an average over everything rather than the colour of any particular star. The value shown approximates the original calculation.
items.funZh: 这个色有个不严谨的地方常被提起：他们只统计了发光的天体，而宇宙里还有大量不发光的物质，跟它们没有关系。而且随着恒星演化，这个平均值本身也在慢慢变 —— 按计算，它以后会越来越偏红。
items.funEn: One imprecision is often raised: the figure covers only luminous matter, and has nothing to say about the much larger quantity that emits no light. The average is also drifting as stars evolve — the calculation suggests it will grow steadily redder with time.

items.histZh: 佩恩灰是十八世纪英国水彩画家威廉·佩恩常用的一种灰，由深蓝、黑和一绺红调成，色相偏蓝而非中性。它后来的名气远超佩恩本人：水彩画里阴影、石头、云层几乎都用它，因为它比纯粹的灰更有空气感，又不像纯黑那样把画面压死。屏幕上的值是近似值。
items.histEn: Payne's grey is a grey associated with the eighteenth-century English watercolourist William Payne, mixed from a dark blue, black and a touch of red, and therefore blue-leaning rather than neutral. It outgrew its namesake entirely: in watercolour it is used for shadow, stone and cloud almost as a default, because it carries more atmosphere than a plain grey and does not deaden a picture the way pure black does. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 佩恩灰能流行起来，靠的正是「不是中性灰」这一点。中性灰在画面里会显得死板，因为它不含任何色相倾向，跟周围一切都不发生关系；而偏蓝的灰会自动被读成阴影 —— 这是空气散射留给人的视觉经验。
items.funEn: What made it popular is precisely that it is not a neutral grey. Neutral greys sit inertly in a picture because they carry no hue and therefore relate to nothing around them, whereas a blue-leaning grey is read automatically as shadow. That reading comes from visual experience with atmospheric scattering.

items.histZh: 胡克绿得名于十九世纪英国植物学家和插画师威廉·胡克，是普鲁士蓝与藤黄调出的一个深绿，专门用来画叶子。它解决的是植物画里的一个具体问题：天光下的叶片不是一种绿，向阳面和背面差得很远，而单一颜料画不出来，所以需要一个能自由调整的基色。屏幕上的值是近似值。
items.histEn: Hooker's green is named after the nineteenth-century British botanist and illustrator William Hooker: a deep green mixed from Prussian blue and gamboge, made specifically for painting foliage. It solves a concrete problem in botanical work. A leaf under daylight is not one green — the lit face and the underside differ greatly — and no single pigment supplies both, so what is needed is a base that can be adjusted freely. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 植物插画至今仍要给新物种留下「模式标本图」，也就是鉴定时依据的那张画。这种图的要求很严格：颜色要随标本状态说明，因为同一种植物在不同季节、不同光照下颜色完全不同 —— 颜色在这里是可复核的证据。
items.funEn: Botanical illustration still has to produce the type illustration for a new species, the drawing that identification relies on. The requirements are strict, and colour has to be qualified by the state of the specimen, since the same plant differs entirely by season and by light. Colour here is evidence that can be checked.

items.histZh: 牛顿把白光分成七色，靛排在蓝和紫之间，位列第六。现在普遍认为这一个是被「凑」出来的：他需要七个色来对应音阶的七个音和当时已知的七个天体，于是把蓝紫之间那一段单独拎了出来。今天的色彩科学里，靛很少被当作一个独立的色相。屏幕上的值是后人对那一档的近似还原。
items.histEn: Newton split white light into seven colours and placed indigo sixth, between blue and violet. It is now widely thought that this one was manufactured: he needed seven to match the seven notes of the scale and the seven bodies then known, so the stretch between blue and violet was carved out as its own band. Indigo is rarely treated as a separate hue in colour science today. The value shown is a modern approximation of that band.
items.funZh: 牛顿之所以执着于七这个数字，理由之一是他相信光的性质应该跟音乐一样有比例关系 —— 色带和音阶可以逐一对应。这个信念在当时是合理的，但它把观察往结论上推了一把，多出来的那一段就是这么来的。
items.funEn: Part of Newton's attachment to seven was a conviction that light should behave proportionally, like music, so that the colour band and the musical scale could be matched one to one. The belief was reasonable for its time, but it pushed the observation toward the conclusion, and the extra band is what resulted.

items.histZh: 兰花紫是 2014 年的潘通年度色，偏红的紫、明度中等。这门年度色评选从 2000 年前后开始，每年发布一个色，声称是对当下情绪的判断。它实际上更像一份市场预测：颜色一旦被宣布，服装、家居、印刷会跟着走，然后这个颜色真的就变多了。屏幕上的值是近似值。
items.histEn: Radiant orchid was the Pantone colour of 2014: a red-leaning purple at moderate lightness. The annual selection began around 2000 and announces one colour a year, presented as a reading of the prevailing mood. It functions more as a market forecast: once the colour is announced, clothing, interiors and print follow, and the colour genuinely does become more common. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 这类「预测」有个自我实现的成分：公布之后供应链会按它排产，媒体会按它做选题，于是它真的流行了。所以年度色更像是一份协同日历，而不是一份气象报告 —— 它预报的是产业在什么时候会一起往哪走。
items.funEn: There is a self-fulfilling element to such forecasts. Once announced, supply chains plan around it and media commission around it, and it does become popular. A colour of the year is therefore closer to a coordination calendar than to a weather report: what it forecasts is where an industry will move together, and when.

items.histZh: 草木绿是 2017 年的潘通年度色，黄绿、明度偏高，接近新叶。宣布那年正是环保议题在公共讨论里升温的时候，官方说明也直接写了「复兴、清新、自然」。黄绿这个色相在服装上向来不好卖 —— 它挑肤色 —— 所以选它本身就带着一点冒险。屏幕上的值是近似值。
items.histEn: Greenery was the Pantone colour of 2017: a yellow-green at fairly high lightness, close to a new leaf. It was announced at a moment when environmental questions were rising in public discussion, and the official statement said as much, invoking renewal, freshness and nature. Yellow-green has always been a hard sell in clothing because it is unforgiving against skin, so the choice carried some risk. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 黄绿挑肤色这件事有生理依据：它的色相跟皮肤里血红蛋白和黑色素透出的色调处在相邻区间，两者放在一起容易互相污染。所以黄绿的衣服在浅肤色和深肤色上呈现出的效果差别特别大。
items.funEn: The difficulty of yellow-green against skin has a physiological basis: its hue sits adjacent to the tones that haemoglobin and melanin give the skin, and the two contaminate each other. A garment in that colour therefore behaves very differently on light and deep complexions.

items.histZh: 紫外光（2018 年年度色）取的是偏冷的深紫，明度低、饱和中高。名字里的「紫外」其实是修辞 —— 紫外线的波长比可见光短，人是看不见的，所以任何屏幕上的紫都不可能真的是紫外。这一类名字借的是物理名词的气势，而不是它的定义。屏幕上的值是近似值。
items.histEn: Ultra violet, the 2018 selection, is a cool deep purple at low lightness and moderate to high saturation. The ultra in the name is rhetorical: ultraviolet has a shorter wavelength than visible light and cannot be seen, so nothing on a screen can literally be ultraviolet. The name borrows the authority of a physics term rather than its definition. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 借物理名词给颜色命名的做法很常见，也容易出错：红外、紫外、X 光这些词都指人眼看不见的波段。用它们形容颜色，等于用一个「看不见」的词来描述「看见」的东西 —— 商业命名里这种矛盾不少。
items.funEn: Borrowing physics terms for colours is common and error-prone: infrared, ultraviolet and X-ray all name bands the eye cannot see. Using them to describe a colour means describing something visible with a word that means invisible, a contradiction that commercial naming produces often.

items.histZh: 活珊瑚是 2019 年的潘通年度色，是珊瑚橙偏粉的一档，明度高、饱和高、显得暖和。选它的时候珊瑚白化正被广泛报道，于是这个选择立刻引来了批评：一个以珊瑚命名的颜色，出现在珊瑚正在死去的年份。官方回应说这个色是「活的」，指的不是珊瑚的处境。屏幕上的值是近似值。
items.histEn: Living coral was the 2019 selection: a coral orange leaning pink, high in both lightness and saturation, and warm to look at. Coral bleaching was being widely reported at the time, and the choice drew immediate criticism — a colour named after coral, in a year when coral was dying. The official response was that the colour is the living kind, which says something about coral rather than about its situation. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 这类争议的核心不是颜色本身，而是命名的时点：同一个色号，放在不同的年份公布，读出来的意思完全不同。品牌命名一旦碰上正在发生的公共议题，就很难只被当成审美看待。
items.funEn: The argument was never really about the colour but about the timing. The same value announced in a different year reads entirely differently. Once a brand name collides with an unfolding public issue it becomes very hard to treat as merely aesthetic.

items.histZh: 经典蓝是 2020 年的潘通年度色，是一种沉稳的正蓝，明度中低、不带青。它公布的时候被解读为「求稳」—— 那一年全球的公共情绪确实偏紧张。选一个不激进、不新鲜的颜色，本身就是一种态度：不提供刺激，提供安定。屏幕上的值是近似值。
items.histEn: Classic blue was the 2020 selection: a sober true blue at moderate to low lightness, without a cyan cast. Its announcement was read as a wish for steadiness, and public mood that year was indeed anxious. Choosing a colour that is neither provocative nor novel is itself a position: offering reassurance rather than stimulation. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 有意思的是这个色公布之后不久，全球进入了长时间的居家状态 —— 年度色的意义被现实直接改写了。后来几年选出的暖色和明亮色，回头看往往也被读成「恢复期」的信号。
items.funEn: Not long after it was announced the world went into prolonged lockdown, and reality simply overwrote the colour's meaning. The warmer and brighter selections of the following years have similarly been read in hindsight as signals of convalescence.

items.histZh: 极致灰是 2021 年潘通双年度色中的一个，色相几乎中性，微偏冷。选一对颜色而不是一个，这在年度色的历史上是第二次 —— 上一次是 2016 年的玫瑰石英配静谧蓝。官方的说法是「两个独立的元素互相支撑」，但更直接的解读是：那一年需要同时表达「稳定」和「希望」。屏幕上的值是近似值。
items.histEn: Ultimate gray was one half of the Pantone selection for 2021, essentially neutral with a slight cool cast. Choosing a pair rather than a single colour was only the second time the programme had done so, the first being rose quartz with serenity in 2016. The stated reasoning was two independent elements supporting one another, but the simpler reading is that the year required stability and hope to be expressed at once. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 灰在色彩体系里处境特殊：它既不是色相也不是无彩色，而是饱和度接近零的一段区间。所以「能不能把灰当主色」这件事，几乎每个品牌都会遇到一次，而答案通常跟行业的情绪周期有关。
items.funEn: Grey occupies an odd position in any colour system: neither a hue nor a non-colour, but the region where saturation approaches zero. Every brand eventually has to decide whether grey can carry a primary role, and the answer usually tracks the emotional cycle of its industry.

items.histZh: 亮丽黄是 2021 年潘通双年度色里的另一个，明度极高、饱和中等，接近正午的阳光黄。它跟极致灰配在一起，逻辑很清楚：灰提供分量，黄提供温度。这两个色放在一起时，灰会显得更冷，黄会显得更暖 —— 对比会同时加强双方。屏幕上的值是近似值。
items.histEn: Illuminating was the other half of the 2021 pairing: very high in lightness, moderately saturated, close to noon sunlight. Its logic against the grey is clear — the grey supplies weight and the yellow supplies warmth. Side by side, the grey reads cooler and the yellow warmer; the contrast intensifies both. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 「对比加强双方」是色彩同时对比的经典现象：把同一个灰放在黄旁边和放在蓝旁边，测出来的观感明度会不一样。这不是错觉，而是视觉系统在做局部归一化的结果。
items.funEn: Mutual intensification is the classic simultaneous contrast effect: the same grey placed beside yellow and beside blue will be judged as different in lightness. It is not an illusion but the result of the visual system normalising locally.

items.histZh: 摩卡慕斯是 2025 年的潘通年度色，是带粉调的暖褐，明度中等、饱和偏低。这个色在传统色体系里对应的是土地、咖啡、皮革那一类，属于「让人放松的中间色」。年度色从高饱和转向这类低饱和的中性暖色，被普遍认为反映了消费情绪从表达转向内敛。屏幕上的值是近似值。
items.histEn: Mocha mousse was the 2025 selection: a warm brown with a pink cast, mid-range in lightness and low in saturation. In traditional vocabularies this is the territory of earth, coffee and leather, a comfortable middle tone. The programme's shift from high saturation toward muted warm neutrals has been widely read as consumer mood moving from expression toward restraint. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 低饱和的暖褐在商业上有现实优势：它跟绝大多数肤色、木色和金属都不冲突，所以特别好卖。代价是它不出镜 —— 一个用在包装上不会出错，但也不会被记住的颜色。
items.funEn: Muted warm browns have a practical commercial advantage: they conflict with almost no skin tone, wood or metal, and therefore sell easily. The cost is that they never steal a scene — a colour that cannot go wrong on packaging and will not be remembered either.

items.histZh: 卡其来自乌尔都语和印地语里的「khākī」，字面意思就是「土色的」。十九世纪中期英属印度军队把白色制服染成土黄，因为白衣服在战场上太显眼 —— 一次纯实用的改装，最后变成了全世界军服和工装的基础色。屏幕上的卡其是近似值，实际军服的卡其从鼠灰到土黄跨度极大。
items.histEn: Khaki comes from khākī in Urdu and Hindi, literally meaning dusty or earth-coloured. In the mid-nineteenth century the British Indian Army dyed its white uniforms an earth yellow because white was dangerously conspicuous in the field. A purely practical modification ended up supplying the base colour of military and work clothing worldwide. The value shown is an approximation; real service khaki ranges from mouse grey to earth yellow.
items.funZh: 把制服染成土色这件事在当时的军事逻辑上是革命性的：在此之前，军服的思路是「越醒目越能震慑对手」，卡其之后变成了「越看不见越能活下来」。颜色的意义被武器射程直接改写了。
items.funEn: Dyeing uniforms earth-coloured was a revolution in military logic. Before it, the reasoning ran that the more conspicuous the uniform the more it overawed the enemy; afterwards it became the less you are seen the more likely you survive. Weapons range rewrote the meaning of a colour directly.

items.histZh: 牛津蓝是牛津大学的校色，是一种很深的正蓝，明度低到接近黑。它跟剑桥的浅蓝形成对照，而这两所学校的赛艇对抗赛正是靠颜色区分的 —— 「浅蓝对深蓝」在英语里干脆成了一句俗语。校色在这里的作用很原始：在一群穿同样衣服的人里，一眼分出敌我。屏幕上的值是近似值。
items.histEn: Oxford blue is the university's colour: a very dark true blue, low enough in lightness to sit near black. It contrasts with Cambridge's pale blue, and the two universities' boat race is distinguished by exactly that — light blue against dark blue became a stock phrase in English. The job of a varsity colour is elementary here: to tell friend from rival at a glance among people wearing identical clothing. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 牛津和剑桥的浅蓝色之争有个流传很久的说法，说剑桥最初用的是浅蓝，后来因为褪色被嘲笑，索性就把褪色版的蓝定成了正式校色。这个故事缺乏可靠的文献支持，但它能流传下来，说明大家愿意相信「失误变传统」这种事。
items.funEn: A long-circulating story holds that Cambridge originally used a blue that faded, was mocked for it, and adopted the faded version as its official colour. Reliable documentation is lacking, but the tale survives because people are willing to believe that an accident can become a tradition.

items.histZh: 剑桥蓝是一种带灰的浅蓝绿，严格说更接近浅青。它是剑桥大学各运动队的代表色，跟牛津的深蓝正好构成一对。这种「浅对深」的配对在体育里很实用：在赛艇这种远距离、快速掠过的场景里，明度的差别比色相的差别更容易被瞬间识别。屏幕上的值是近似值。
items.histEn: Cambridge blue is a greyed pale blue-green, strictly closer to a light cyan. It represents the university's sports teams and forms a deliberate pair with Oxford's dark blue. The light-against-dark pairing is practical in sport: in rowing, where the boats pass at speed and at distance, a difference in lightness is registered instantly where a difference in hue is not. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 远距离识别颜色时，明度比色相重要得多 —— 因为色觉依赖的视锥细胞在视野边缘分布稀少，而明暗感知覆盖整个视野。所以赛艇、球衣、信号旗的配色几乎都以明度差为第一原则。
items.funEn: At distance, lightness matters far more than hue, because the cone cells that support colour vision are sparse in peripheral vision while brightness is perceived across the whole field. Racing colours, jerseys and signal flags are therefore built on lightness contrast first.

items.aliasZh: 橄榄石绿 · 橄榄绿宝石
items.histZh: 橄榄石绿取橄榄石（贵橄榄石）的颜色，是明亮偏黄的绿，色相落在黄绿区间。橄榄石在古埃及被称作「太阳的宝石」，据说克利奥帕特拉收藏过。它在矿物学上其实是橄榄石族的一个成员，而整个橄榄石族在地幔里大量存在 —— 地球上很多绿其实是它给的。屏幕上的值是宝石典型色的近似值。
items.histEn: Peridot green is the colour of the gem: a bright yellow-leaning green. The stone was called the gem of the sun in ancient Egypt, and Cleopatra is said to have collected it. Mineralogically peridot is one member of the olivine group, and olivine is abundant in the mantle — a great deal of the green in the earth is attributable to it. The value shown approximates a typical stone.
items.funZh: 橄榄石有个特点：它几乎只在一个色相里出现，从黄绿到偏橄榄的绿，不会像别的宝石那样有红有蓝。原因是它致色的铁离子在晶体结构里的位置固定，能变化的范围很窄 —— 一颗宝石的颜色，被矿物结构锁死了。
items.funEn: Peridot occurs in essentially one hue family, from yellow-green to olive, and does not range across the spectrum the way some gems do. The reason is that the iron responsible for its colour occupies a fixed site in the crystal structure, leaving very little room to vary. The colour is locked in by structure.

items.histZh: 石榴石红取石榴石的典型暗红，偏褐、明度低。石榴石在中文里的名字来自它的颗粒状晶体，长得像石榴籽；英文 garnet 则来自拉丁语的「石榴」。两个语言各自看到了同一种水果，都拿它来命名这颗石头 —— 这在矿物命名里挺少见。屏幕上的值是近似值。
items.histEn: Garnet red is the stone's characteristic dark red, brown-leaning and low in lightness. The Chinese name derives from the granular crystals, which resemble pomegranate seeds; the English word descends from the Latin for pomegranate. Two languages each noticed the same fruit and named the stone after it, which is unusual in mineral naming. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 石榴石其实不是一个矿物，而是一整个族：成分相近、结构相同，按金属离子不同分成好几个品种，颜色从深红到绿到橙都有。其中绿色的那一种叫沙弗莱石，六十年代才在非洲发现，一度比红宝石还贵。
items.funEn: Garnet is not one mineral but a family: similar in composition and identical in structure, divided into species by which metal ion is present, with colours running from deep red through green to orange. The green member, tsavorite, was only found in Africa in the 1960s and was briefly dearer than ruby.

items.histZh: 紫水晶是紫色的石英，颜色来自晶格里的铁杂质。它在古代属于贵重宝石，因为那时只有少数产地能出浓紫的晶体；等到南美的大型矿床被发现之后，价格一落千丈，从「贵重宝石」变成了常见的半宝石。同一个石头，地位被供应链改写了一遍。屏幕上的值是近似值。
items.histEn: Amethyst is violet quartz, coloured by iron impurities in the lattice. In antiquity it ranked as a precious stone, since only a few sources produced deep violet crystals; once large South American deposits were found, the price collapsed and it moved from precious to commonplace. A single stone whose standing was rewritten by supply. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 紫水晶的紫色对光和热都不太稳定：长期暴晒会褪成浅黄或发白，加热到几百度则会变成黄水晶甚至绿水晶 —— 天然紫水晶之所以有深浅之分，一部分就是地质历史里受热程度不同造成的。
items.funEn: Amethyst's violet is not stable against light or heat: prolonged sunlight fades it toward pale yellow or white, and heating it a few hundred degrees produces citrine or even green quartz. Part of the natural variation in depth is simply how much heat a crystal saw in its geological past.

items.histZh: 绿松石是铜铝磷酸盐矿物，颜色从天空蓝到苹果绿都有，取决于成分里铜与铁的比例 —— 铜多偏蓝，铁多偏绿。它在中国、波斯和中美洲都被用了很久，是最早被开采的宝石之一。中文名里的「松」据说来自它常呈松球状的结核形态。屏幕上的值是常见蓝绿色档的近似值。
items.histEn: Turquoise is a copper aluminium phosphate whose colour runs from sky blue to apple green depending on the ratio of copper to iron in its composition: more copper gives blue, more iron gives green. It was used over a very long period in China, Persia and Mesoamerica and is among the earliest gemstones to be mined. The Chinese name is said to refer to the pine-cone shape the nodules often take. The value shown approximates the common blue-green grade.
items.funZh: 绿松石有个在宝石里罕见的性质：它会「变」。汗液、油脂和化妆品都能渗进它多孔的晶体结构，时间一长颜色就变深变暗。所以一串老珠子跟新珠子放一起，颜色差得很明显 —— 是老化的证据，不是品质问题。
items.funEn: Turquoise has a property rare among gemstones: it changes. Sweat, oils and cosmetics all penetrate its porous structure, and over time the colour deepens and dulls. An old strand of beads set beside a new one therefore differs plainly — evidence of ageing rather than a defect.

items.histZh: 黄玉在中文里是矿物名，指含氟铝硅酸盐；而珠宝市场上说的「托帕石」多数其实是经过处理的，天然带色的很贵，无色的一加热或辐照就能变成蓝的。所以市面上大量蓝色托帕石并不是挖出来的颜色，是做出来的。屏幕上的黄玉取天然黄色品种的典型色，是近似值。
items.histEn: Topaz in Chinese is a mineral name for a fluorine-bearing aluminium silicate, but most of what the jewellery trade sells under it has been treated: naturally coloured stones are expensive, while colourless material can be turned blue by heating or irradiation. A large share of blue topaz on the market is therefore a made colour, not a found one. The value shown approximates the natural yellow variety.
items.funZh: 黄玉的「改名」是中国珠宝市场的一个常见混淆点：矿物学上的黄玉（托帕石）和黄玉髓、黄水晶经常被混着叫。真正区分它们的办法是看硬度和晶体形态，而不是看颜色 —— 颜色在这个行业里最不可靠。
items.funEn: The naming is a common source of confusion in the Chinese market, where topaz, yellow chalcedony and citrine get spoken of interchangeably. Distinguishing them means hardness and crystal form rather than colour, which is the least reliable indicator in the trade.

items.histZh: 月光石是正长石的一种，颜色本身是半透明的乳白，特别之处在于它表面会流动一层蓝白的光，叫「晕彩」。成因是石头内部由两种长石交替叠成的极薄层，光在里面发生干涉和散射。所以月光石的美不在颜色，而在光的行为。屏幕上的值是近似平均值，无法表现它的晕彩。
items.histEn: Moonstone is a variety of orthoclase whose own colour is a translucent milky white; what sets it apart is a drifting blue-white glow across the surface, known as adularescence. It arises from extremely thin alternating layers of two feldspars inside the stone, at which light interferes and scatters. The beauty lies in the behaviour of light rather than in the colour. The value shown is an approximate average and cannot convey the sheen.
items.funZh: 月光石的晕彩跟孔雀羽毛、蝴蝶翅膀是同一类机制：结构色。区别在于孔雀羽毛的结构在表面，而月光石的结构藏在石头里，所以它看起来像光从内部浮上来 —— 古人因此相信它跟月亮有关。
items.funEn: Moonstone's sheen works by the same mechanism as a peacock feather or a butterfly wing: structural colour. The difference is that the feather's structure sits on the surface while the stone's is buried inside, so the light appears to rise from within. That is why earlier observers connected it to the moon.

items.aliasZh: 知更鸟蛋蓝 · 蛋壳蓝
items.histZh: 知更鸟蛋蓝取某些鸟蛋壳的蓝绿色。这个颜色在生物学上有个长期未解的问题：蛋壳的色素到底从哪来。直到近年研究才比较明确 —— 是雌鸟在形成蛋壳时把体内的胆绿素转递进去，而胆绿素正是血红素的分解产物。所以蛋的蓝，跟淤青发青是同一类物质。屏幕上的值是近似值。
items.histEn: Robin's egg blue is the blue-green of certain bird eggshells. Biologically the colour posed a long-standing puzzle about where the pigment came from, and only recent work has established it with reasonable confidence: the female transfers biliverdin, a breakdown product of haem, into the shell as it forms. The blue of an egg and the green of a bruise come from the same family of substances. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 蓝色的蛋壳为什么会进化出来，目前主要有两种解释：一是蓝色蛋壳能挡住部分紫外线，保护里面的胚胎；二是它像一种「健康证明」—— 能产出足够胆绿素的雌鸟状态更好，蛋的颜色就成了给雄鸟看的信号。
items.funEn: Two main explanations compete for why blue eggshells evolved: that the blue screens some ultraviolet and protects the embryo, or that the shell acts as a certificate of health, since a female able to produce plenty of biliverdin is in better condition, making the colour a signal to males.

items.histZh: 鲑鱼粉取鲑鱼肉的颜色，是偏橙的粉，明度较高。这个颜色有一层容易被忽略的事实：野生鲑鱼的橙红来自它吃的小型甲壳类里的虾青素，是「吃出来的颜色」；养殖鲑鱼如果不额外添加虾青素，肉就是灰白的。所以超市里那片橙红，本质上是配方决定的。屏幕上的值是近似值。
items.histEn: Salmon is the colour of the fish's flesh: a pink leaning orange, fairly light. There is an easily missed fact behind it. The orange-red of wild salmon comes from astaxanthin in the small crustaceans it eats, so the colour is eaten rather than made; farmed salmon fed no added astaxanthin has greyish flesh. What is on the supermarket tray is essentially decided by the recipe. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 养殖鲑鱼的粉红色是行业里公开的事情，通常会在饲料里加虾青素，还会用色卡来定级 —— 一片鱼排属于哪一档，靠比对标准色卡决定，跟收成水果时看糖度是同一套思路。
items.funEn: The pinkness of farmed salmon is openly acknowledged in the industry, with astaxanthin added to the feed and the resulting fillets graded by comparison against a colour chart. Which tier a piece belongs to is settled by holding it against a standard, much as sugar content settles a fruit harvest.

items.histZh: 鳄梨绿取鳄梨外皮的颜色，是发暗的黄绿。它在设计史上有一层特殊含义：上世纪七十年代的家电和厨房用品大量使用这个色，后来它跟那个年代一起被嫌弃了几十年，成了「过时」的代名词。近十年它又翻了身，回到家居和时尚里 —— 同一个色号，两次被时代选中，两次的原因完全不同。屏幕上的值是近似值。
items.histEn: Avocado green is the colour of the fruit's skin: a dark yellow-green. It has a particular place in design history, having been used across appliances and kitchenware in the 1970s, then dismissed along with the decade for several generations and treated as a synonym for out-of-date. In the last decade it has come back into interiors and fashion — the same value chosen twice by the times, for entirely different reasons. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 颜色的「过时」往往不是审美判断，而是联想问题：鳄梨绿之所以被嫌弃，是因为它绑定了具体的一批产品和装修风格。等那批东西从生活里消失、只剩照片之后，这个颜色就重新变得中立了。
items.funEn: A colour going out of fashion is usually about association rather than aesthetics. Avocado green was disliked because it was bound to a specific generation of products and interiors. Once those left daily life and survived only in photographs, the colour became neutral again.

items.histZh: 南瓜橙取南瓜果肉和果皮的颜色，是高饱和的暖橙。南瓜原产美洲，传入中国之后迅速推广，明代的文献里已经有记载，后来还成了荒年顶饱的作物。它在英语世界里几乎等同于万圣节，在中文里则更多跟秋天和丰收连在一起 —— 同一个色相，两套完全不同的文化剧本。屏幕上的值是近似值。
items.histEn: Pumpkin orange is the colour of the flesh and rind: a highly saturated warm orange. The squash is native to the Americas and spread rapidly after reaching China, appearing in Ming records and later becoming a crop that carried people through bad harvests. In English-speaking countries it is practically a synonym for Halloween; in Chinese it connects more with autumn and harvest. One hue, two entirely different cultural scripts. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 南瓜的橙色来自类胡萝卜素，跟胡萝卜、番茄是同一类色素。这类色素是脂溶性的，所以吃南瓜时如果同时摄入油脂，吸收率会明显提高 —— 营养学上「同一锅菜怎么搭」确实有区别。
items.funEn: Pumpkin's orange comes from carotenoids, the same family of pigments as carrots and tomatoes. They are fat-soluble, so eating squash alongside some fat measurably improves absorption. What else is in the pot genuinely matters nutritionally.

items.histZh: 茄子紫在英语里是一个常用的颜色词，指那种暗而闷的紫；它在中文传统色里也有对应，属于菜蔬色那一支。这个色的特点是不鲜、不亮，明度低，所以适合大面积的深色织物和家具。注意它和「茄紫」是同一格 —— 中文里两者常混用，实际指的是同一类颜色。屏幕上的值是近似值。
items.histEn: Eggplant is a common colour word in English for a dark, muted purple, and Chinese has a matching term belonging to the vegetable branch of its vocabulary. The colour is neither bright nor fresh and sits low in lightness, which suits it to large areas of dark cloth and furniture. Worth noting that the two Chinese renderings are used interchangeably and describe the same family. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 茄子皮的紫色来自花青素里的翠雀素，同样对酸碱敏感：细胞液偏酸时偏红，偏碱时偏蓝。所以同一颗茄子，不同部位的颜色能差出一小档，切开之后接触空气还会继续变化。
items.funEn: The purple of an aubergine skin comes from delphinidin in the anthocyanin family, and is similarly pH-sensitive: acid pushes it red, alkali blue. A single fruit can therefore vary a step across its own surface, and a cut face keeps changing in air.

items.histZh: 珍珠白是珍珠表面的底色，是带暖调的乳白，而不是纯白。珍珠的颜色来自碳酸钙薄层和有机质交替堆叠，跟月光石一样属于结构色，所以它总有那么一层随角度变化的柔光。真珍珠的「白」因此从来不是均匀的一块。屏幕上的值取常见品种的底色，是近似值。
items.histEn: Pearl white is the ground tone of a pearl's surface: a warm milky white rather than a pure one. The colour arises from alternating thin layers of calcium carbonate and organic material, making it a structural colour like moonstone, which is why it always carries a soft glow that shifts with the angle. The whiteness of a real pearl is never an even field. The value shown approximates a common variety.
items.funZh: 珍珠层是贝类一层层分泌出来的，每层厚度不到一微米，一年可能只长出零点几毫米。所以一颗大珠需要很多年，而它表面的那种柔光，本质上是一摞极薄的透明层对光反复反射的结果。
items.funEn: Nacre is secreted layer by layer, each under a micron thick, accumulating perhaps a fraction of a millimetre in a year. A large pearl therefore takes many years, and its soft lustre is at bottom the result of light bouncing repeatedly through a stack of very thin translucent sheets.

items.histZh: 龙虾红是甲壳类煮熟后的那种鲜艳橙红。活龙虾多半是深蓝褐或暗绿，煮熟变红的原因在于色素蛋白：虾青素平时跟蛋白质结合着，被遮住了颜色；加热之后蛋白质变性，虾青素被释放出来，红色就显出来了。所以这个颜色其实是「蛋白质坏掉」的结果。屏幕上的值是近似值。
items.histEn: Lobster red is the vivid orange-red a crustacean takes on after cooking. A live lobster is usually dark blue-brown or dull green, and the change comes down to a pigment-protein complex: astaxanthin is normally bound to a protein that masks its colour, and heat denatures the protein, freeing the pigment so the red shows. The colour is the result of a protein coming apart. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 虾青素本身是红色的，在活体里被蛋白质「包」着才显不出颜色。同一套机制在虾、蟹、磷虾身上都有，也是为什么煮虾的水会变红 —— 溶出来的那部分色素已经脱离了蛋白质的保护。
items.funEn: Astaxanthin is red on its own; in living tissue it is masked by the protein it binds. The same arrangement appears in shrimp, crabs and krill, and it is why the water a shrimp boils in goes red: the colour that leaches out has already been released from its protein.

items.histZh: 提香红得名于威尼斯画家提香笔下反复出现的红发，是一种偏橙的暖红。在西方绘画里，它慢慢变成了一个独立的名词，专门用来形容那种偏铜色的头发 —— 不管是画里的还是真人。一个颜色被一个画家的偏好固定下来，然后脱离绘画进入了日常用语，这是不多见的。屏幕上的值是近似值。
items.histEn: Titian red is named after the red hair that recurs throughout the Venetian painter's work: a warm, orange-leaning red. It detached from the paintings and became a standing term in Western usage for hair of a coppery cast, in art and in life alike. A colour fixed by one painter's preference and then moving from painting into ordinary language is uncommon. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 提香晚年的用色发生了明显变化，红褐用得更多、笔触也更松。艺术史上对原因有不止一种解释，其中包括他年龄增长之后视力的变化 —— 但这类推断缺乏直接证据，只能算一种可能。
items.funEn: Titian's palette shifted markedly late in life, with more red-browns and looser handling. More than one explanation has been offered, among them changes in his eyesight with age, though such inferences lack direct evidence and remain only plausible.

items.aliasZh: 凯利绿 · 凯利绿宝石色
items.histZh: 凯利绿是一种明亮鲜艳的正绿，名字的来历不完全清楚，比较常见的说法是来自一个爱尔兰姓氏 —— 因为这种绿在爱尔兰和爱尔兰裔社区里被广泛使用。它在二十世纪中期成为美国运动队和校服常用的颜色，跟「三叶草绿」一起构成了爱尔兰绿的两种版本。屏幕上的值是近似值。
items.histEn: Kelly green is a bright, vivid true green whose name is not fully accounted for; the common explanation traces it to an Irish surname, the colour being widely used in Ireland and among Irish communities. It became a standard choice for American sports teams and school uniforms in the mid-twentieth century and, alongside shamrock green, forms one of the two versions of Irish green. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 「爱尔兰绿」其实是两个色：凯利绿偏亮偏黄，三叶草绿偏深偏冷。圣帕特里克节的游行队伍里两种都能看到，而官方场合用的多是偏深的那一种 —— 同一面国旗的颜色，在不同的实物上并不统一。
items.funEn: Irish green is really two colours: kelly green runs bright and yellow-leaning, shamrock green deeper and cooler. Both appear in St Patrick's Day parades, while official occasions tend toward the deeper one. A single national colour turns out not to be uniform across objects.

items.histZh: 猎人绿是深沉的黄绿，据说来自英国乡间猎装的颜色 —— 在林地里有掩护作用，同时又不至于像军用伪装那样引起误会。它在二十世纪中期被大量用在学校、社团和企业标识上，因为它足够深、够正式，放在白纸上又不会显得沉闷。屏幕上的值是近似值。
items.histEn: Hunter green is a deep yellow-green, said to come from English country hunting dress, where it blends into woodland without resembling military camouflage closely enough to cause confusion. It was widely adopted by schools, clubs and companies in the mid-twentieth century: dark enough to read as formal, not so dark as to look heavy on white. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 打猎穿绿色这个传统有个实际问题：绿在林地里的伪装效果其实一般，倒是能让同行的猎人互相看见、避免误伤。所以猎装色的功能一半是隐蔽，一半是「让队友认出你」。
items.funEn: Green for hunting carries a practical contradiction: it does a mediocre job of concealment in woodland, but it does let hunting companions see each other and avoid accidents. Hunting colour is halfway between hiding and being identified by your own side.

items.histZh: 薄荷绿是一种偏青的清凉绿，明度中等。它跟薄荷这种植物其实只有间接关系：这个名字主要靠的是薄荷给人的清凉联想，而不是薄荷叶的实际颜色 —— 真正的薄荷叶要更深更黄。颜色命名里这种「借感觉不借实物」的情况不少。屏幕上的值是近似值。
items.histEn: Mint is a cool green leaning cyan, moderate in lightness. Its relation to the plant is indirect: the name draws on the sensation of coolness that mint suggests rather than on the colour of the leaf, which is deeper and yellower than the colour. Borrowing a feeling rather than an object is a recurring habit in colour naming. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 「薄荷」在商业上是一整条产品线：牙膏、口香糖、洗护用品大多用这个色，因为它们主打的是清凉感。颜色在这里不是描述味道，而是替味道做广告 —— 甚至连不含薄荷的产品也这么用。
items.funEn: Mint is a whole product category commercially: toothpaste, chewing gum and personal care overwhelmingly use the colour because what they sell is freshness. The colour is not describing a flavour but advertising one, and products containing no mint use it too.

items.histZh: 婴儿蓝是一种极浅的蓝，明度高、饱和低。它跟性别分工的关系其实比多数人想的短：在二十世纪初，欧洲和美国给男孩用粉、女孩用蓝的做法都有过，直到二十世纪中期之后，蓝色才比较固定地归到男孩名下。所以「蓝是男孩的颜色」是晚近的共识，不是古老传统。屏幕上的值是近似值。
items.histEn: Baby blue is a very pale blue, high in lightness and low in saturation. Its association with gender is far more recent than most people assume: in the early twentieth century, dressing boys in pink and girls in blue was done in both Europe and America, and only after the mid-century did blue settle fairly firmly on boys. The idea that blue is the boy's colour is a recent consensus rather than an old tradition. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 颜色跟性别的绑定在不同国家并不一致，而且几十年就会翻一次。所以看老照片时用今天的配色规则去判断孩子的性别，经常会判错 —— 那些规则当年还不存在。
items.funEn: The binding of colours to genders differs between countries and flips within decades. Judging a child's sex in an old photograph by today's conventions therefore misfires often, because those conventions did not yet exist.

items.histZh: 海军蓝是极深的蓝，接近黑。它得名于英国皇家海军在十八世纪中期把制服定为深蓝，目的是跟对手的红色制服区分开 —— 在此之前，各国海军并没有统一的颜色。这个色后来脱离了海军，成为西装、制服和正式场合的默认深色之一。屏幕上的值是近似值。
items.histEn: Navy blue is a very deep blue, close to black. It takes its name from the Royal Navy's decision in the mid-eighteenth century to dress its officers in dark blue in order to distinguish them from the red of rival forces; before that, navies had no uniform colour to speak of. The colour then left the navy behind and became one of the default darks for tailoring, uniforms and formal occasions. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 深蓝在海水里比黑色更难被发现，这本来是选它做海军制服的实际理由之一 —— 掉进海里时，深蓝在水下没那么显眼。后来这个颜色成了「正式」的代名词，跟它最初的功能已经没什么关系了。
items.funEn: Deep blue is harder to spot against seawater than black, which was one practical argument for the naval choice: a man overboard in dark blue was less conspicuous in the water. The colour later became a synonym for formality, a connection with no remaining trace of its original function.

items.histZh: 午夜蓝是带紫调的极深蓝，明度低到接近黑。它跟海军蓝经常被混用，区别在于午夜蓝更偏紫、在光线下会显出明显的蓝紫，而海军蓝是纯正的中性深蓝。这类「近黑的有彩色」在服装和汽车漆上很常见，因为它们比黑色有层次，又不至于太高调。屏幕上的值是近似值。
items.histEn: Midnight blue is an extremely deep blue with a violet cast, low enough to sit near black. It is often used interchangeably with navy, the difference being that midnight leans violet and shows a clear blue-purple in light, whereas navy is a true neutral dark blue. Near-black chromatics of this kind are common in clothing and car paint because they have more depth than plain black without drawing attention. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 近黑的有彩色在染整上有个难处：要做出「看着是黑、光照下才透出颜色」的效果，染料浓度必须控制得很准。浓度差一点，要么彻底变成黑，要么就露出明显的蓝紫 —— 这也是为什么这类面料往往比纯黑贵。
items.funEn: Near-black colours are difficult to dye: producing something that reads as black and only reveals its hue under light requires the dye concentration to be held within a narrow band. A little too much and it becomes plain black, a little too little and the blue-violet shows through. It is part of why such fabric costs more than a straightforward black.

items.histZh: 焦糖色取熬糖熬到开始变色的那一档，是带橙的暖褐黄。它在中餐里有个具体用法 —— 炒糖色：把糖炒到变色再下肉，靠糖的焦化给菜上色和增香。所以这个色名在中文语境里带着明确的厨房记忆，而不只是一种描述。屏幕上的值是近似值。
items.histEn: Caramel is sugar taken to the point where it begins to colour: a warm brown-yellow with orange in it. In Chinese cooking it has a specific application, frying sugar to colour before adding meat, using caramelisation both to tint and to flavour the dish. The colour word accordingly carries a definite kitchen memory in Chinese rather than functioning only as description. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 炒糖色的温度窗口很窄：大约在一百六十到一百八十度之间。温度不够只化不黄，过了就会发苦。所以这一步没有计时器可用，全靠看颜色和闻味道 —— 一个完全靠感官判断的临界点。
items.funEn: The window for frying sugar to colour is narrow, somewhere between 160 and 180 degrees. Below it the sugar only melts; beyond it the result turns bitter. No timer helps, and the step is judged entirely by watching the colour and smelling the pan: a threshold read by the senses.

items.aliasZh: 玛萨拉 · 玛萨拉酒红
items.histZh: 玛萨拉是 2015 年的潘通年度色，取西西里玛萨拉葡萄酒的颜色：一种带褐的暗红，饱和低、明度中等。它是年度色评选中少见的「不讨好」选择 —— 既不鲜艳也不轻快。这种偏灰的暖红在室内设计里很实用，因为它几乎不跟任何木色冲突。屏幕上的值是近似值。
items.histEn: Marsala was the Pantone selection for 2015, named for the Sicilian fortified wine: a brownish dark red, low in saturation and moderate in lightness. It was an unusual choice for the programme in being uningratiating — neither bright nor buoyant. This kind of greyed warm red is practical in interiors because it conflicts with almost no wood tone. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 玛萨拉酒本身有个特别的工艺：在发酵过程中加入烈酒，让糖分保留下来。所以它既不是完全发酵的酒，也不是简单调和的酒 —— 颜色里的那点褐，跟这个工艺是连着的。
items.funEn: Marsala wine has a distinctive process: spirit is added during fermentation so that some sugar remains. It is therefore neither a fully fermented wine nor simply a blended one, and the brown in its colour is connected to that method.

items.histZh: 玫瑰石英是 2016 年潘通双年度色里的粉色一半，是一种极浅的粉，明度极高、饱和极低。它跟静谧蓝配成一对，官方说法是「性别界限的模糊」。这种极浅的粉在儿童产品和家居里长期占位，但它同时也是最容易被评价为「没性格」的一档颜色。屏幕上的值是近似值。
items.histEn: Rose quartz was the pink half of the 2016 Pantone pairing: an extremely light pink, very high in lightness and very low in saturation. It was paired with serenity, and the stated reasoning was a blurring of gender boundaries. This kind of pale pink has long occupied children's products and interiors, and it is also the shade most easily dismissed as characterless. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 极浅的颜色有一个实际的优势：它们的面积可以做得很大而不压迫。所以室内、包装、界面底色的浅色往往比鲜艳色更耐看 —— 代价是单独使用时几乎没有存在感。
items.funEn: Very light colours have a practical advantage: they can occupy a large area without pressing on the eye. That is why interiors, packaging and interface grounds favour pale colours for durability of effect, at the cost of almost no presence when used alone.

items.histZh: 静谧蓝是 2016 年潘通双年度色里的蓝色一半，是一种带灰的浅蓝，明度偏高。它跟玫瑰石英的明度非常接近，这正是双色搭配成不成立的关键 —— 两个色如果明度差太多，放在一起就会一个抢一个。灰调的蓝在这里起了稳定作用。屏幕上的值是近似值。
items.histEn: Serenity was the blue half of the 2016 pairing: a greyed pale blue at fairly high lightness. Its lightness sits very close to rose quartz's, which is exactly what makes a two-colour pairing work — if the two differ much in lightness one will dominate the other. The grey in the blue steadies the combination. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 双色搭配比单色难得多，因为要同时满足两个条件：明度接近才不会失衡，色相有距离才不会糊成一块。静谧蓝和玫瑰石英基本算是一份标准答案 —— 明度几乎同档，色相正好隔开。
items.funEn: Pairing two colours is much harder than choosing one, because two conditions must hold at once: similar lightness so neither dominates, and enough hue distance so they do not merge. Serenity with rose quartz is close to a textbook answer — lightness matched, hue separated.

items.histZh: 探戈橘是 2012 年的潘通年度色，是高饱和的暖橙红。这个色公布的时候正赶上经济刚从危机里缓过来，官方的说明用了「振奋」「活力」这类词。它是年度色里偏激进的一档 —— 明度高、饱和高，用在服装和包装上很跳，但大面积使用会累。屏幕上的值是近似值。
items.histEn: Tangerine tango was the 2012 selection: a highly saturated warm orange-red. It was announced as the economy was emerging from crisis, and the official language invoked energy and uplift. It is one of the more aggressive choices the programme has made — high in lightness and saturation, striking on clothing and packaging, tiring over a large area. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 高饱和的暖色有个共同的用法限制：适合做强调，不适合做底。所以这类年度色通常出现在配饰、包装和宣传物料上，很少真的被大面积刷进家里 —— 流行色的落地方式，往往跟它宣传时展示的样子不一样。
items.funEn: Highly saturated warms share a practical limit: they work as accents and fail as grounds. Such colours of the year therefore turn up on accessories, packaging and campaign material and rarely get painted across a room. How a trend colour is finally used rarely resembles how it was presented.

items.histZh: 翠玉绿是 2013 年的潘通年度色，是偏青的深绿，饱和中高。它在宝石里对应的是祖母绿，在色彩上更接近青绿之间偏绿的位置。选它的时候，奢侈品和珠宝市场正在恢复，这个绿恰好也带着一层「贵重」的联想 —— 年度色跟产业周期之间的关系，往往比跟审美潮流更紧。屏幕上的值是近似值。
items.histEn: Emerald was the 2013 selection: a deep green leaning cyan, moderately to highly saturated. It corresponds to the gemstone in name and sits toward the green end of the blue-green band. Luxury and jewellery markets were recovering when it was announced, and the colour carries an association with value — the colour of the year usually tracks industry cycles more closely than it tracks aesthetics. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 「翠玉绿」和「翡翠色」在中文里都指向宝石，但一个是潘通色号、一个是传统色名，两个体系的取色方法完全不同：一个靠印刷标准，一个靠实物目测。名字撞车不代表数值接近。
items.funEn: The two Chinese names both point at the gemstone, but one is a Pantone specification and the other a traditional colour word, and the two systems derive colour in entirely different ways: one from print standards, the other from looking at an object. Sharing a name implies nothing about the numbers.

items.aliasZh: 开心果绿 · 开心果色
items.histZh: 开心果绿取开心果果仁的颜色，是柔和的黄绿，明度中高、饱和偏低。它在甜品和冰淇淋里是最常用的口味标示色之一，因为它比抹茶绿浅、比薄荷绿黄，落在「坚果 + 奶」的联想区间里。屏幕上的值是近似值，实际果仁的颜色随品种和烘烤程度变化。
items.histEn: Pistachio is the colour of the nut kernel: a soft yellow-green, moderately light and low in saturation. It is among the most used flavour markers in desserts and ice cream, being paler than matcha and yellower than mint, and therefore landing in the association zone of nut plus cream. The value shown is an approximation; real kernels vary with variety and roasting.
items.funZh: 天然开心果的绿色其实来自叶绿素，而烘烤会让它褪色，所以市面上颜色特别鲜绿的多半是加了色素 —— 尤其是带壳的那种，壳上的白和仁的绿对比得过于整齐，基本可以判断是处理过的。
items.funEn: The green in a natural pistachio comes from chlorophyll, which roasting fades, so kernels of an especially vivid green have usually been dyed. The shelled sort is the giveaway: the contrast between a chalk-white shell and an even green kernel is too tidy to be natural.

items.aliasZh: 鼠尾草绿 · 鼠尾草色
