items.histZh: 鼠尾草绿取鼠尾草叶的颜色，是蒙了一层灰的浅绿，饱和低、明度中高。它在近十年的室内设计里极受欢迎，因为它几乎不跟任何其他颜色冲突 —— 木头、石材、白墙，放在一起都成立。这类「万能色」的共同点是低饱和，代价是很难成为主角。屏幕上的值是近似值。
items.histEn: Sage is the colour of the sage leaf: a greyed pale green, low in saturation and moderately light. It has been extremely popular in interiors over the last decade because it conflicts with almost nothing — wood, stone and white walls all sit comfortably beside it. Such universal colours share low saturation, and the cost is that they rarely lead. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 「不冲突」这件事在色彩上是可以量化的：颜色之间冲突主要来自两个来源，一个是明度太接近又没有色相差，一个是饱和都太高。低饱和色把第二条路堵死了，所以剩下的冲突可能就小很多。
items.funEn: Not conflicting is partly quantifiable. Colour clashes come mainly from two sources: lightness that is too similar with no separation in hue, and saturation that is too high on both sides. A desaturated colour closes off the second route, which removes most of the remaining risk.

items.histZh: 巧克力色取可可固形物的颜色，是暖调的深褐。它在工业上有很强的实用性 —— 皮革、木材、家具几乎都能跟它相处，所以长期是箱包和家具的常备色。这个色还有一层认知上的特点：它比中性褐偏红偏橙，看起来更「有味道」，这是食品类用它的原因。屏幕上的值是近似值。
items.histEn: Chocolate is the colour of cocoa solids: a warm dark brown. Its industrial usefulness is considerable, since leather, timber and furniture all coexist with it easily, which has kept it a standing choice for bags and case goods. It also has a perceptual feature: warmer and more red than a neutral brown, it reads as having flavour, which is why food uses it. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 巧克力色的「味道感」其实是联觉在起作用：同一个色相，偏橙偏红的褐会被联想到烘烤和焦糖，偏灰偏冷的褐会被联想到泥土。所以食品包装的褐几乎都往暖里调。
items.funEn: The sense of flavour is synaesthesia at work. Within one brown family, the warmer, redder versions are read as roasted and caramelised, while the grey, cooler ones are read as soil. Food packaging therefore pushes its browns warm almost without exception.

items.histZh: 香槟色取香槟酒的颜色，是极浅的暖黄，明度高、饱和低。它在商业上被大量用于婚礼和礼品包装，因为它同时具备两个条件：够浅，显得干净；偏暖，显得贵重。这类「浅金」还有个实用优势 —— 印刷时比金属色便宜得多，却能传递类似的联想。屏幕上的值是近似值。
items.histEn: Champagne is the colour of the wine: an extremely pale warm yellow, high in lightness and low in saturation. It is heavily used in weddings and gift packaging because it meets two conditions at once — pale enough to look clean, warm enough to look valuable. This kind of pale gold has a practical advantage too: far cheaper to print than a metallic, while carrying a similar association. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 真金属色印刷要单独上一道工艺，成本和工序都比普通四色高。所以「看起来像金但不是金」的浅黄一直是包装行业的主力 —— 用一层颜色解决一个原本需要材料才能解决的问题。
items.funEn: Printing a true metallic requires its own pass and costs more in both money and process than ordinary four-colour work. A pale yellow that looks like gold without being it has therefore long been a mainstay of packaging: one flat colour solving a problem that would otherwise need a material.

items.histZh: 松露色取松露菌体的颜色，是带灰的深褐，明度低。松露在烹饪里地位很高，价格也高，所以「松露」这个色名在商品命名里常被借去暗示档次 —— 松露色的皮革、松露色的包装，卖的其实是那个联想。这个现象在颜色命名里很普遍：借的是物件的价位，不是它的色相。屏幕上的值是近似值。
items.histEn: Truffle is the colour of the fungus: a greyed dark brown, low in lightness. Truffles carry high status and a high price in cooking, so the name gets borrowed in product naming to imply a tier — truffle leather, truffle packaging — which is to say what is being sold is the association. Borrowing an object's price rather than its hue is a common move in colour naming. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 松露之所以贵，很大一部分原因在栽培：它需要跟特定的树根共生，人工种植要等好几年才可能出菌，而且产量不可控。所以价格里有一半是「等不起」的成本，跟味道本身关系没那么大。
items.funEn: Much of the price is about cultivation rather than flavour. Truffles require a symbiotic relationship with particular tree roots, and a planted truffle bed may take years to produce anything, with unpredictable yields. Half the cost is simply the inability to wait it out.

items.histZh: 桑葚色指的是桑葚捣碎后那种鲜艳的紫红，比果皮本色更饱和。这个色在英语里也用来指一种紫红的染织物，而它跟中国的桑文化只共享一个物种，不共享用法 —— 中国把桑树养蚕当成农本，欧洲更多把它当果树。同一个色名，两种完全不同的生产背景。屏幕上的值是近似值。
items.histEn: Mulberry names the vivid purple-red of crushed berries, more saturated than the skin itself. In English the word also covers a purple-red dyed cloth, and its relation to Chinese mulberry culture is one of species rather than use: China treated the tree as the foundation of sericulture, while Europe treated it more as a fruit tree. One colour name, two entirely different production contexts. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 桑葚压碎后颜色比果皮更浓，是因为花青素集中在细胞液里，破壁之后才大量释放。所以同一个水果有两种颜色：完整时偏暗偏青，碾碎时鲜亮。取名的人各取一半，才有了这个色名的含糊。
items.funEn: A crushed mulberry is more intense than the skin because the anthocyanins sit in the cell sap and are only released in quantity once the cells are broken. One fruit therefore offers two colours — darker and bluer intact, vivid when crushed — and the name draws on both, which is where its vagueness comes from.

items.histZh: 拿铁咖啡是牛奶加浓缩咖啡的颜色，浅褐偏暖。它在近二十年成了一个流行的家居与服装色，原因很实际：这个色跟白墙、木地板、米色沙发全都不冲突，等于装修时的默认安全选项。颜色一旦成了「安全」，就同时获得了普及和「没个性」这两个评价。屏幕上的值是近似值。
items.histEn: Latte is milk with espresso: a warm pale brown. Over the last two decades it has become a popular colour for interiors and clothing for a practical reason — it conflicts with white walls, timber floors and beige sofas alike, making it the default safe choice in a renovation. Once a colour becomes safe it acquires both ubiquity and the label of having no personality. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 奶咖的颜色其实浮动很大，主要取决于奶泡和咖啡的比例，而不是豆子本身。所以同一句「拿铁色」，在连锁店的纸杯上和在精品店的杯子里能差出一整档明度。
items.funEn: The colour of a latte varies mostly with the ratio of milk foam to coffee rather than with the beans. Two cups sold under the same word can therefore differ by a full step in lightness, depending on whether the paper cup came from a chain or a specialist.

items.histZh: 岩灰取板岩的颜色，是带蓝调的灰，在各种灰里属于偏冷的一档。板岩是变质岩，能沿着层理劈成薄板，所以历史上大量用作屋顶瓦和写字板 —— 英文里的「一张白纸」写作 clean slate，用的就是这块石头。颜色名背后往往是一段材料史。屏幕上的值是近似值。
items.histEn: Slate grey is the colour of slate: a grey with a blue cast, one of the cooler greys. Slate is a metamorphic rock that splits along its bedding into thin sheets, which is why it served historically as roofing and as writing tablets — English still says a clean slate, after the stone. Behind a colour word there is often a history of a material. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 板岩之所以能劈成片，是因为它承受过定向压力，矿物重新排列成了平行的层。所以它「有方向」：顺着层理一敲就开，垂直方向却很难断 —— 材料的性格直接决定了它能被用来做什么。
items.funEn: Slate splits because it was subjected to directed pressure that realigned its minerals into parallel layers. It therefore has a grain: struck along the bedding it comes apart, across it, it resists. The character of the material decides what it can be used for.

items.histZh: 番茄红是带橙的明亮红，明度高。番茄原产南美，十六世纪传入欧洲之后很久被当成观赏植物，因为人们怀疑它有毒 —— 实际上番茄的茎叶确实含少量生物碱，果实则没有。它在中国被接受得也不早，直到近代才成为家常菜的主力。屏幕上的值是近似值。
items.histEn: Tomato is a bright red with orange in it, high in lightness. The plant is native to South America and was grown as an ornamental in Europe for a long time after arriving in the sixteenth century, suspicion of poison being widespread — the stems and leaves do in fact contain small amounts of alkaloids, though the fruit does not. It was late to be accepted in China as well, only becoming a staple of home cooking in recent times. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 番茄的红色来自番茄红素，是类胡萝卜素里的一种。它跟胡萝卜素不同的是更偏红、抗氧化能力更强。而且番茄红素是脂溶性的，加热加一点油之后吸收率会明显上升 —— 番茄炒蛋其实是个很合理的搭配。
items.funEn: The red comes from lycopene, a carotenoid that leans redder than carotene and is a stronger antioxidant. It is fat-soluble, and heating it with a little oil raises absorption appreciably — which makes a tomato-and-egg stir-fry a chemically sensible combination.

items.histZh: 冰川蓝取冰川和冰层的蓝色，是浅而偏灰的青蓝。冰之所以是蓝的，原理跟天空类似但不同：冰的致密结构对红光吸收更多，穿透一定厚度之后剩下的光偏蓝。所以冰越厚越蓝，薄冰几乎是白的 —— 同一个物体，颜色取决于你透过多少去看它。屏幕上的值是近似值。
items.histEn: Glacier blue is the blue of ice: pale, greyish, cyan-leaning. The reason ice is blue is related to the sky but not the same. Dense ice absorbs red light more strongly, so what survives a certain thickness leans blue. Thicker ice is therefore bluer and thin ice is nearly white — one substance whose colour depends on how much of it you are looking through. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 冰的蓝不来自任何色素，而是来自吸收本身。这一点跟天空的散射蓝、孔雀羽毛的结构蓝都不同：同样是「物体显得蓝」，背后的机制却可以有三种完全不同的物理原因。
items.funEn: The blue of ice comes from no pigment at all but from absorption itself. That makes it distinct both from the scattering that blues the sky and from the structural colour of a peacock feather. Three entirely different physical mechanisms, all producing the statement that an object looks blue.

items.histZh: 沙色取细沙的颜色，是极浅的暖米，明度高、饱和低。它的命名逻辑很直接 —— 拿最不缺的实物当参照。有意思的是，沙的颜色其实绝大部分来自石英颗粒，而杂质决定了它偏黄还是偏粉：含铁多的偏红，含贝壳碎屑多的偏白。屏幕上的值是近似值。
items.histEn: Sand colour is fine sand: an extremely pale warm beige, high in lightness and low in saturation. The naming logic is direct, taking the most abundant available object as its reference. Interestingly, most of the colour comes from quartz grains, and the impurities decide whether it leans yellow or pink: iron makes it redder, shell fragments make it paler. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 不同海滩的沙颜色差得很远，从白到黑都有 —— 黑色的沙滩来自火山玄武岩碎屑，粉色的来自有孔虫壳。所以「沙色」这个色名其实是在用一个词覆盖一整个色阶，比多数色名都含糊。
items.funEn: Sand varies enormously from beach to beach, white through black. Black sand comes from volcanic basalt fragments, pink from foraminiferan shells. The colour word therefore covers an entire range with a single term, more loosely than most.
